title: Part-Time Virtual Medical Assistant (VMA)
description:
Clinical Chart Review & Preparation – Internal Medicine / Family Medicine

Position: Part-Time Virtual Medical Assistant

Work Location: Remote

Schedule: Part-Time / Flexible

Focus: Primary Care Chart Preparation, Preventive Care, MAT, Care Gaps & Clinical Chart Review

Position Summary

We are seeking a medically trained Virtual Medical Assistant (VMA) with strong experience in Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Primary Care, or a closely related adult medical specialty.

This is not a basic administrative or data-entry position. The VMA will perform detailed clinical chart preparation and medical record review to help our providers walk into each patient encounter with a clear understanding of the patient's history, current problems, preventive needs, care gaps, medications, laboratory results, and outstanding clinical issues.

The ideal candidate understands longitudinal primary care and can review a medical record with a clinical mindset—identifying information that should be brought to the provider's attention without independently diagnosing, treating, or making clinical decisions.

Primary Responsibilities

Follow-Up Visit Chart Preparation

Review charts before routine and complex follow-up visits and prepare a concise clinical summary for the treating provider.

Review should include:

• Active and historical diagnoses

• Previous assessment and plan

• Recent specialist visits and recommendations

• Current medications and medication changes

• Relevant laboratory and diagnostic results

• Outstanding labs, imaging, referrals, or orders

• Chronic disease monitoring needs

• Preventive services and care gaps

• Items from previous visits that require follow-up

• Potential discrepancies or missing documentation requiring provider review

Annual Wellness Visit Preparation

Perform comprehensive pre-visit chart preparation for Medicare Annual Wellness Visits and other preventive visits.

Preparation may include:

• Review of prior AWV/preventive visit date

• Preventive screening history

• Immunization history

• Cancer screening status

• Fall-risk and functional-assessment needs

• Advance care planning status

• Medication reconciliation

• Appropriate chronic disease monitoring

• Identification of open preventive and quality-measure gaps

• Preparation of information needed for the provider to efficiently complete the visit

Care Gap Review & Closure Preparation

Review patient charts for outstanding care gaps and identify opportunities for appropriate closure.

Examples include:

• Mammography

• Colorectal cancer screening

• Cervical cancer screening

• Diabetic eye examinations

• Diabetic kidney health evaluation

• A1c monitoring

• Blood pressure follow-up

• Vaccinations

• Osteoporosis screening

• Other payer, preventive, or quality-measure requirements

The VMA will determine whether documentation already exists in the chart, whether outside records may need to be obtained, or whether the gap should be brought to the provider's attention.

MAT Chart Review

Prepare charts for patients receiving Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT), including patients receiving buprenorphine products and long-acting injectable therapies.

Review may include:

• Current MAT medication and dose

• Previous treatment plan

• Prescription history documented in the medical record

• Relevant drug-screen results

• Appropriate laboratory monitoring

• Injection history when applicable

• Upcoming or overdue injections

• Medication adherence information documented in the chart

• Relevant behavioral health or recovery information

• Outstanding clinical or documentation items requiring provider attention

Comprehensive Medical Record Review

In addition to visit-specific chart preparation, the VMA will perform broader medical reviews of patient charts to help identify clinical information that may have been missed, overlooked, or not appropriately followed up.

This may include identifying:

• Abnormal laboratory results requiring provider review

• Imaging or diagnostic studies without documented follow-up

• Specialist recommendations that have not been addressed

• Referrals without documented completion

• Chronic conditions without recent monitoring

• Medication discrepancies

• Preventive services that appear overdue

• Incomplete follow-up plans

• Documentation inconsistencies

• Important historical diagnoses or findings that may affect current care

The VMA's responsibility is to identify and flag potential issues for the licensed treating provider, not independently diagnose patients, establish treatment plans, prescribe medications, or make final clinical decisions.

Required Medical Background

This position requires a strong clinical medical background.

Preferred backgrounds include:

• Internal Medicine

• Family Medicine

• General Medicine

• Adult Primary Care

• Geriatric Medicine

• Hospital Medicine or another broad adult medical specialty with substantial experience managing chronic disease

Candidates should be comfortable reviewing patients with multiple chronic medical conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, cardiovascular disease, COPD, obesity, hyperlipidemia, and other common primary-care conditions.

Applicants Who Are Not a Good Fit

Because this position requires broad adult primary-care chart review, applicants whose experience is primarily limited to highly specialized fields generally will not be considered.

This includes applicants whose primary training or experience is in:

• Pathology

• Radiology

• Psychiatry

• Pediatrics

• Other specialties without substantial adult Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, or longitudinal primary-care experience

Qualifications

Candidates should have:

• Formal medical or clinical training

• Strong knowledge of Internal Medicine and/or Family Medicine

• Experience reviewing complex adult medical records

• Understanding of common chronic diseases and their routine monitoring

• Ability to interpret the significance of common laboratory and diagnostic results sufficiently to flag them for provider review

• Familiarity with preventive medicine and age-appropriate screenings

• Excellent attention to detail

• Strong written English communication skills

• Ability to create concise, clinically useful chart summaries

• Experience working in an EHR

• Ability to maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality

Experience with Medicare Annual Wellness Visits, care-gap closure, value-based care, chronic care management, or MAT is highly desirable.

What We Are Looking For

We want someone who approaches a chart like a clinician, not simply like a data-entry specialist.

The successful candidate should be able to review a complex patient record and ask:

What does the provider need to know before seeing this patient? What has changed? What needs follow-up? What preventive or chronic-care needs are outstanding? Is there something in this chart that could easily be overlooked?

The goal of this position is to make every patient encounter more organized, comprehensive, efficient, and clinically informed while leaving diagnosis and treatment decisions with the patient's licensed healthcare provider.

title: Claims, Returns & Recoveries Specialist
description:
Full-Time | Remote – Philippines | Australian Business Hours



We are a growing Australian retail and e-commerce business looking for an experienced Claims, Returns & Recoveries Specialist to take ownership of customer claims, damaged goods, returns, warranties and recoveries from couriers and suppliers.

This is not a general customer service role.

We are specifically looking for someone with previous hands-on experience managing claims, returns, warranties, damaged goods, courier/freight claims, insurance claims or similar cases.



The Role

You will own claims from opening through to final resolution and financial recovery.

You will investigate what happened, gather evidence, communicate with customers, lodge claims with couriers and suppliers, follow up outstanding recoveries and ensure every case continues moving until it is genuinely resolved.



Responsibilities

- Assess new claims, returns, damaged goods and warranty cases.

- Review customer explanations and identify missing or conflicting information.

- Check orders, tracking, proof of delivery, photos, previous correspondence and other evidence.

- Gather and organise supporting documentation.

- Request additional evidence or information where required.

- Determine the appropriate next action based on the evidence and company policies.

- Communicate professionally with customers throughout the process.

- Lodge and manage courier and freight claims.

- Lodge and manage supplier or manufacturer claims.

- Follow up couriers and suppliers until outstanding claims are resolved.

- Coordinate approved replacements, returns, credits and refunds.

- Maintain accurate claim records, statuses and follow-up dates.

- Track outstanding claim values and amounts recovered.

- Assist with evidence for chargebacks where required.

- Escalate unusual, disputed or high-value cases appropriately.

- Identify recurring causes of claims and report patterns to management.

- Ensure no claim sits without action or misses a deadline.

- Keep cases open until both the customer outcome and any required financial recovery are complete.



What We're Looking For

Essential

- Previous hands-on claims, returns, warranty or dispute-management experience.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Excellent organisation and follow-up.

- Strong judgement and attention to detail.

- Comfortable assessing incomplete or conflicting information.

- Able to make reasonable decisions rather than escalating every issue.

- Able to manage multiple claims at different stages simultaneously.

- Professional and calm when dealing with unhappy customers.

- Strong evidence and documentation skills.

- Able to work independently and take ownership.

- Reliable and available during Sydney business hours.



Highly Regarded

Experience with any of the following:

- Courier or freight claims

- Damaged-goods claims

- E-commerce returns

- Product warranties

- Insurance claims

- Supplier/manufacturer recoveries

- Shopify

- Gorgias or another helpdesk/CRM

- Chargeback evidence

- Furniture, appliances, building products or bulky-item deliveries



What Success Looks Like

If you own a claim, management should not need to remind you to follow it up.

At any point, you should know:

What happened → what's missing → what happens next → who owes a response → when to follow up → how much is outstanding → when the case can be closed.

Your performance will be assessed on areas including:

KPI Expectation

Claims responded to on time High compliance

Complete and accurate evidence High

Follow-ups completed by due date 100% target

Missed claim deadlines 0

Claims sitting without action 0

Average resolution time Continually improve

Courier/supplier recoveries Track value and recovery rate

Outstanding claim value Actively managed

Ageing of unresolved claims Minimise

Case records Accurate and current

Customer communication Clear and professional

Unnecessary management escalation Low



Working Hours

Monday–Friday: 9:00am–5:00pm Sydney time

Saturday: 10:00am–4:00pm Sydney time (optional)

Monday–Friday Sydney hours are required. Saturday availability is preferred but not required.



How to Apply

Please keep your application short and specific.

Include:

1. Your previous experience managing claims, returns, warranties or similar cases.

2. Approximately how many active cases you managed at one time.

3. The systems and tools you used.

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD.

5. Your earliest available start date.

6. Whether you are available on Saturdays.



Important

We are interested in your actual experience and judgement.

You may use AI tools such as ChatGPT to assist with spelling, grammar or formatting, but your answers must reflect real work you personally performed.

Please do not submit generic, hypothetical or AI-generated examples that do not reflect your own experience. Short, specific answers are preferred.

We may ask you to discuss the details of your example during an interview.

Required Application Question

Tell us about one real claim you personally managed from start to finish.

Briefly explain:

- What happened?

- What did you check first?

- What evidence did you collect?

- Who did you contact?

- How did you follow it up?

- What was the final outcome?

- Was any money recovered? If so, approximately how much?

- At what point did you consider the case closed?

Please use a real example from your own work experience, not a hypothetical scenario.

title: Recruitment Manager
description:
Recruitment Manager – Job Description



Position: Recruitment Manager

Department: Human Resources / Recruitment

Reports To: Senior Management / Operations Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Onsite / Hybrid, depending on business requirements



Job Summary



The Recruitment Manager is responsible for overseeing the company’s end-to-end recruitment operations, ensuring that the organization consistently attracts, evaluates, and hires qualified candidates based on business requirements.



The role involves leading the recruitment team, developing hiring strategies, monitoring recruitment KPIs, managing candidate pipelines, coordinating with department heads, and ensuring that hiring targets are met within the required timelines and quality standards.



Key Responsibilities



1. Recruitment Team Management



Lead, supervise, and manage the Recruitment Officers and recruitment staff.

Assign daily recruitment activities, hiring targets, and candidate pipelines.

Monitor individual and team performance.

Conduct coaching, feedback sessions, and performance reviews.

Establish accountability and productivity standards for the recruitment team.



2. End-to-End Recruitment



Oversee the complete recruitment process from sourcing to onboarding.

Review and improve recruitment procedures to ensure efficient candidate movement.

Conduct or oversee initial and final interviews for critical positions.

Ensure proper candidate screening based on job requirements and company standards.

Coordinate background checks, character references, assessments, and pre-employment requirements.



3. Recruitment Strategy & Workforce Planning



Develop recruitment strategies based on current and projected manpower requirements.

Work closely with Operations and Management to understand hiring needs.

Establish sourcing strategies for high-volume and specialized positions.

Maintain an active candidate pipeline for upcoming hiring requirements.

Develop contingency hiring plans for urgent manpower requirements.



4. Recruitment KPI Management



Track and analyze recruitment performance on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.

Monitor KPIs such as:

Number of applicants

Qualified candidates

Interview-to-hire ratio

Hiring conversion rate

Time-to-fill

Time-to-hire

Attendance/interview show-up rate

Offer acceptance rate

Recruitment source effectiveness

New-hire retention

Prepare recruitment reports and provide recommendations to Management.



5. Sourcing & Talent Acquisition



Develop and maintain multiple candidate sourcing channels.

Utilize job platforms, social media, employee referrals, recruitment networks, and other sourcing methods.

Evaluate the effectiveness of each recruitment source.

Build talent pools for recurring and hard-to-fill positions.

Develop strategies to attract qualified candidates in competitive hiring markets.



6. Interview & Candidate Assessment



Ensure interviews are structured, consistent, and aligned with the position requirements.

Assess candidates based on qualifications, experience, communication skills, attitude, work ethics, and cultural fit.

Ensure recruitment decisions are supported by documented interview results and assessments.

Coordinate with hiring managers regarding candidate recommendations.



7. Coordination with Hiring Managers



Work closely with Operations Managers, Team Leaders, Department Heads, and Senior Management regarding manpower requirements.

Confirm job descriptions, qualifications, salary expectations, schedules, and hiring timelines.

Provide regular updates on recruitment progress and potential hiring challenges.

Recommend adjustments to hiring strategies when recruitment targets are at risk.



8. Recruitment Process Improvement



Identify bottlenecks within the recruitment funnel.

Improve candidate screening, interview scheduling, assessment, and onboarding processes.

Develop standardized interview guides, evaluation forms, and recruitment procedures.

Implement systems and tools that improve recruitment efficiency and candidate experience.



9. Employer Branding



Help strengthen the company's reputation as an employer.

Ensure job advertisements accurately represent the company and available positions.

Develop recruitment campaigns and initiatives to attract qualified applicants.

Maintain professional communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.



10. Compliance & Documentation



Ensure recruitment activities follow company policies and applicable employment regulations.

Maintain accurate and confidential candidate records.

Ensure proper documentation of interviews, assessments, offers, and pre-employment requirements.

Protect candidate information and maintain appropriate confidentiality.



Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Management, or a related field.

3–5+ years of recruitment experience, with at least 1–2 years in a supervisory or managerial role preferred.

Experience managing a recruitment team.

Experience handling high-volume recruitment is highly preferred, particularly in BPO, sales, customer service, or similar environments.

Strong knowledge of sourcing, interviewing, screening, and candidate assessment.

Strong understanding of recruitment KPIs and funnel management.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to work under pressure and meet aggressive hiring deadlines.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, ATS, CRM, or recruitment management systems.



Preferred Skills

Talent acquisition and workforce planning

High-volume recruitment

Recruitment analytics and reporting

Interviewing and candidate assessment

Recruitment marketing and sourcing

Team leadership and coaching

Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)

Employer branding

Stakeholder management

Process improvement

Conflict resolution

Data-driven decision-making

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KPI Measurement

Hiring Target Achievement Percentage of required positions filled within the target period

Time-to-Fill Average number of days required to fill an open position

Time-to-Hire Time from candidate application/qualification to accepted offer

Interview Conversion Percentage of interviewed candidates who progress to hiring

Offer Acceptance Rate Percentage of offered candidates who accept

Interview Attendance Rate Percentage of scheduled candidates who attend

title: AI Video Creator
description:
Willed is looking for an AI Video Creator to create high-performing, story-driven video ads and content.



We're not looking to churn out generic AI content.



We want to make memorable ads built around great stories — creative that stops the scroll, creates an emotional response and drives people to take action.



You'll work directly with our marketing team, taking ideas from concept and script through to AI production, editing and finishing creatives.



We're looking for someone who wants to push the boundaries of what an AI video can do — not simply generate another talking-head avatar or generic AI video.



What You'll Do

> Storytelling & Scripting

- Develop original concepts for Meta, Google and Tiktok.

- Write compelling scripts with strong hooks, narrative arcs and payoffs.

- Turn complex or sensitive subjects into stories people actually want to watch.

- Develop different creative concepts, hooks and angles for testing.

- Collaborate with the Head of Growth & Marketing to turn marketing objectives into compelling stories.

> AI Video Creation

- Use leading AI tools for video, image, voice, music and visual effects.

- Take projects from idea → script → storyboard → generation → edit → finished ad.

- Experiment with emerging AI models and creative workflows.

- Push AI beyond its obvious use cases to create distinctive, cinematic and original work.

- Combine AI-generated content with conventional editing and production techniques.

- Continuously experiment with new ways to improve quality, speed and creative possibilities.

> Performance Advertising

- Create video ads specifically for Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok.

- Understand what makes people stop scrolling and keep watching.

- Produce different hooks, concepts, lengths and formats for creative testing.

- Work with the Head of Growth & Marketing to analyse performance and develop better creative.

- Balance creative ambition with measurable commercial results.

> We're Looking for a Creator, Not an Editor

- You will own the creative process.

- We want someone who can take a blank page and turn it into a finished piece of advertising.

- You don't need to wait for someone to hand you a script, footage or storyboard.

- You can come up with the idea, write the story, create the visuals, generate the footage, edit the video and deliver the final ad.



What We're Looking For

- You might be a filmmaker, creative director, copywriter, content creator, VFX artist, animator or someone who has become obsessed with the possibilities of generative AI.

- Your background matters less than what you can make.



You should have:

- Strong storytelling and scripting ability.

- Hands-on experience with generative AI video tools.

- A strong visual and creative eye.

- Experience creating short-form video for social media or advertising.

- An understanding of hooks, attention and audience psychology.

- The ability to rapidly experiment, iterate and improve.

- Curiosity about emerging AI models and creative techniques.

- Strong practical understanding using Claude Code or OpenAI Codex as part of your workflows. 

- Commercial awareness and an understanding that creative needs to perform.



We Don't Want AI Slop

- We're not interested in producing hundreds of interchangeable AI videos.

- We want original, story-driven advertising that people actually want to watch.

- You should care about the difference between technically impressive and genuinely good.

- If you see a new AI capability and immediately start thinking:

"What could I make with this?"

—you'll probably enjoy this role.



Portfolio

- Your portfolio matters more than your qualifications.

- Show us your best work, particularly:

- AI-generated video

- Story-driven content

- Meta or Google advertising creative

- Short films or narrative work

- Experimental AI projects

- We'd rather see one exceptional piece of work than twenty generic AI videos.



About Willed

Willed is an Australian digital company providing online Wills, probate and legal services, prepaid funerals and at-need funeral services.

Our subject matter gives us an unusual creative challenge.

We're dealing with deeply human themes — family, love, mortality, legacy and the people we leave behind.

We want to tell those stories in ways that are unexpected, compelling and emotionally engaging.

AI gives us the opportunity to tell stories and create advertising that would previously have required production budgets far beyond our reach.



The Opportunity

- You'll work directly with the Head of Growth & Marketing to develop Willed's next generation of advertising creative.

- You'll have significant freedom to experiment, test new ideas and explore the limits of what AI video can currently do.

- This isn't a role where you'll be handed a template and asked to produce 20 videos a week.

- We're trying to make something genuinely good.



If you're excited by the idea of asking "What if we could make this?" — and then figuring out how to actually make it — we'd like to hear from you.



How to Apply

> Please provide:

- Your resume or LinkedIn profile

- A portfolio/showreel of your best work

- Examples of AI video you've created

- A brief description of your most ambitious AI video project yet

- Links to any ads you've produced



Show us what you can make.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back



How to Apply:

Click the link - 
/o/JB-EG02TR292/landing

title: Accounts Payable & Receivable Officer Remote WFH
description:
We are a growing freight forwarding company specialising in sea and air freight transport solutions looking for an experienced Accounts Payable and Receivable Officer to join our team. 



The role is to manage and optimize the accounts payable / receivable process, ensuring timely invoice processing and maintaining accurate financial records in Excel, Xero and Cargowise. High attention to detail is essential, as you will be ensuring financials are accurate and up to date. You will be responsible for monitoring and reporting on outstanding debts, collection issues in collaboration with customers and internal teams, while developing strategies to minimize overdue accounts. 



This role is ideal for a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in a remote environment and values process improvement and accuracy. We are looking for someone who is reliable, disciplined, proactive, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work as part of a supportive and professional team.



Key Responsibilities:

Invoicing and Billing:

• Accurately enter supplier invoices into Excel, Xero and Cargowise

• Ensure invoices comply with relevant tax requirements (e.g. GST treatment, ABN details)

• Support continuous improvement initiatives within accounts payable and finance processes.



Receivables Management:

• Monitor the accounts receivable ledger and reconcile customer accounts

• Allocate incoming payments against invoices accurately and in a timely manner

• Identify and resolve discrepancies between payments received and amounts invoiced



Debtor Management:

• Follow up on overdue accounts via phone, email, and written correspondence

• Weekly reporting of aged debtors including tracking debt collection activity.

• Reconciliation and Reporting



Administrative Support:

• Maintain customer/client master data within Xero accounting system

• Assist with ad hoc finance tasks as required

• Prepare and create bank files for weekly and monthly payment runs.

• Assist with month-end tasks, reporting, and reconciliation activities.



Requirements:

• Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

• Minimum of 2-3+ years’ experience in an Accounts Payable or similar finance role

• Strong computer literacy and confidence using multiple systems

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Microsoft 365 and SharePoint and Google suite

• Proven experience using Xero (essential)

• High level organisational and time management skills

• Experience with Australian GST regulations and compliance

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision or direction

• Reliable, disciplined, and proactive work ethic

• High attention to detail and data accuracy in system work

• Clear communicator with a professional, team-first attitude



Equipment Needed:

• Desktop or Laptop under 3 years old

• Dual monitor – 2 x Screens required

• Core I5 or Ryzen 5 & above

• Min 8GB RAM

• Min 500GB Hard Drive

• Microsoft windows genuine version

• Fibre Internet – Minimum 100MBps & above

• Backup Internet – Second pre-paid ‘dongle’ style

• Backup Power – UPS or Generator



Wage: PHP 30,000 – PHP 50,000 per month with government mandated benefits based on experience and skills



Benefits:

• Full time work from home role

• Day shift working 8:30am – 5:00pm Monday to Friday Australian business hours 

• No weekend work

• Holiday & sick leave

• Australian national public holidays

description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

title: Outbound Sales · Account Acquisition · Sales
description:
Outbound Sales · Account Acquisition · Sales



Maverick Creative Group is a California digital marketing agency. We build complete growth systems for

American small businesses — websites, funnels, CRM automation, paid advertising, AI phone and chat

assistants, and video and podcast production. Our clients are the people who keep American homes and

neighborhoods running: contractors, plumbers, HVAC and roofing companies, real estate agents, and medical

and dental clinics.

We are not a lead-mill and this is not a robocall job. Every call you make is to a business owner, from our own

US phone numbers, on a scrubbed and compliant list, inside our own CRM. We take that seriously and we will

train you on exactly how it works.

What you will actually do

You are the first human voice an American business owner hears from Maverick. Your job is to start real

conversations, find out whether we can genuinely help, and book qualified appointments onto a senior

closer's calendar. You are not asked to close the sale or quote a price — you are asked to find the right

people and earn the meeting.

Day to day:

Make 80–120 outbound calls per day to US small business owners from our own dialer

Follow up on inbound leads from our Free Audit Report funnel, usually within five minutes of the lead

arriving

Ask real qualifying questions — what they run, how they get customers now, what is broken, whether they

can actually afford to fix it

Book qualified appointments into our calendar and make sure they show up: confirmation, reminder,

reschedule

Log every call, note and outcome in GoHighLevel, accurately and the same day

Read and follow our call compliance rules on every single call, without exception

Hand off a clean, written summary so the closer walks into the call already informed

Who we are looking for

Required:

Two or more years of outbound phone sales or appointment setting to US or Canadian customers.

This is the single thing we will not flex on. We are not able to train phone sales from zero on this shift.

Clear, confident, natural spoken English. You will be talking to skeptical, busy, often blunt American

business owners who will interrupt you. You need to be understood immediately and hold your ground

warmly.

You can take a "no" and keep your energy on the next call. Most of these calls end in a no. That is the

job.

Reliable fiber internet (10 Mbps or better), a quiet room, and a proper headset. No cafes, no

background noise, no mobile data.

Willing and genuinely able to work 11:00 p.m. – 8:00 a.m. Manila time, Monday to Friday, to cover US

Pacific business hours. Please only apply if you have done a night shift before and know you can sustain

it.

Strongly preferred — say so if you have it:

Hands-on experience in GoHighLevel (or a comparable CRM such as HubSpot, Close, or Salesforce)

You have sold marketing, web design, SaaS, or agency services — not just insurance, travel or

collections

You have sold to home services or real estate — contractors, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, realtors

Comfortable on video for internal team calls.

How to apply — please read, most applicants skip this

Applications that do not include all three items below will not be reviewed. This is our first test of whether you

follow instructions, which matters a great deal on a compliance-sensitive phone team.

1. A voice recording, 60–90 seconds. Do not read a script. Imagine you have just reached the owner of a

plumbing company in Los Angeles who did not expect your call and sounds busy. Open the call and try to

earn two minutes of their time. Send an audio file or an unlisted link.

2. Answer these in writing:

What was your last outbound role, what exactly were you selling, and to whom?

How many dials did you make on a typical day, and how many appointments did you book in a typical

week?

Describe the shift you worked and how long you sustained it.

Have you used GoHighLevel? If yes, what did you do in it?

1. Start your reply with the word MAVERICK so we know you read this to the end.

We reply to every applicant who follows these three steps.



Maverick Creative Group ,  

CEO

title: Customer support / service - front end call taker - after sales support
description:
Customer Service & Sales Support VA – Australian E-Commerce Business



We are an Australian e-commerce business specialising in commercial cleaning equipment and machinery. We are looking for a reliable, confident and professional Customer Service & Sales Support Virtual Assistant to become the first point of contact for many of our customers.



This is a customer-facing role involving inbound phone calls, customer enquiries, order support, sales leads and after-sales service.



We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, is comfortable speaking with Australian customers, takes ownership of problems and can provide a high level of customer service.



Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Answering inbound customer phone calls during Australian business hours

* Acting as the first point of contact for new and existing customers

* Responding to customer enquiries by phone and

* Answering general product, pricing, availability and delivery questions

* Gathering information from customers and identifying what product or solution they require

* Recording sales leads and customer enquiries for follow-up

* Following up customers who have requested quotes or product information

We are more interested in finding someone who:

 communication skills

Driver Recruiting / Administrative Support

title: Social Media Manager for Health & Wellness Creator (TikTok + Instagram + Youtube)
description:
I run a personal channel and brand about palatal expansion, jaw and airway health, and general wellness. I have a YouTube channel and a TikTok that have both been running for a while, and I am now starting an Instagram account from scratch.



I am looking for someone to take the social side of this off my plate so I can stay focused on making the content.



HAVE A LOOK BEFORE YOU APPLY

YouTube: 

TikTok: 

Instagram: 



Spend a few minutes with these before you write to me. It will tell you more about the tone and the subject than I can explain here, and it will make your application better.



THE FIRST PROJECT

Right now my back catalogue is scattered. Some things went up on YouTube Shorts and never made it to TikTok. Some went to TikTok and never made it to YouTube. Nothing is on Instagram yet.



Your first job is to sort that out:

- Go through both accounts and build me a simple spreadsheet of what exists where

- Identify what is missing from each platform

- Gather the video files so the gaps can be filled

- Start building out a posting plan for the new Instagram account using the back catalogue



That first audit tells me a lot about how you work, so take it seriously.



ONGOING WORK

- Keeping a schedule of what posts where and when, across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts

- Writing a caption for each post. Sometimes that means writing a fresh one, sometimes it means reusing or adapting the caption from wherever the clip was posted before. Use your judgment.

- Keeping all three platforms in sync going forward so this does not drift again

- Flagging what is working and what is not



WHERE THE VIDEO FILES COME FROM

Most clips will come from a Google Drive folder I keep with the finished exports. For older posts where I do not have the original file, you will need to pull the video down from YouTube or TikTok.



One thing to know about watermarks. Clips downloaded from TikTok come out with a TikTok watermark on them. That is fine for YouTube, so use them there when it is the only copy available. Do not use a watermarked clip for Instagram, because Instagram suppresses reposted video with another platform's watermark visible.



So the order to work in: my original file if I have it, then a YouTube download, then a TikTok download. Anything going to Instagram has to be clean.



HOW ACCOUNT ACCESS WORKS

My accounts are personal accounts and I am not converting them, so I cannot give you a separate login of your own. I am also not handing out my passwords.



The way this works instead: you prepare everything and I publish it. You put the video file, the caption, the platform and the date into a shared folder and schedule sheet, and I post it from my phone. It takes me under a minute per post.



If you are looking for a job where you log into someone's accounts and run them yourself, this is not that job. If you are comfortable owning the planning, the writing and the organization while I handle the button press, we will get along well.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Organized. This job is mostly about keeping track of what has gone where, and doing it consistently.

- Good written English. The captions go out in my voice on my personal brand, so they need to read naturally.

- Comfortable with a spreadsheet. The audit is a spreadsheet job and the schedule lives in one.

- Familiar with how TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts each work. They are not interchangeable and captions and hashtags do not translate one to one.

- Willing to learn the subject. I talk about jaw development, breathing, and airway health. You do not need a background in it, but you do need to be interested enough to get the terminology right.

- Reliable and communicative. If something is unclear, ask before you queue it up.



HOURS AND PAY

$4/hour to start, part-time, around 15 hours per week. There is room for more, both in rate and in hours, based on experience and how things go. I am open to discussing it.



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ THIS PART CAREFULLY

1. Tell me about social accounts you have managed. Which platforms, whose accounts, and what you were responsible for.

2. Send 2 or 3 examples of captions you have written. Screenshots or links are both fine.

3. Write a short paragraph on why this kind of content interests you.

4. At the very end of that paragraph, add the word: kiwi



Applications without that word will not be read. It tells me you read the whole posting.



PLEASE DO NOT START ANY WORK YET

Do not begin the audit, do not send sample captions beyond the ones asked for above, and do not post anything anywhere.



I read every application and reply to the people I want to move forward with. Work is only assigned after I have accepted your application and we have agreed on it. I cannot pay for anything done before that point, so please do not spend your time on it.

title: Solar Project Coordinator
description:
Location: Remote 

Company: STOR Power



STOR Power is a California-based residential solar and battery installation company seeking an experienced solar professional to manage internal communication between our sales representatives and operations team.



We need someone with extensive solar industry knowledge, excellent written and spoken English, and strong follow-through. We will train you on our CRM and internal processes. You should already understand how residential solar projects move from a signed agreement through installation and permission to operate.



About the Role



You will be the primary point of contact for sales representatives requesting project updates.



When a representative asks about a project, you will review our CRM, check project notes and milestones, and provide a clear, accurate response. When additional information is needed, you will coordinate with the appropriate operations team member, obtain the answer, and follow up with the representative.



Your job is to keep sales representatives informed, organize incoming questions, and allow operations to stay focused on moving projects forward.



Responsibilities



* Respond professionally to sales representatives’ project questions through internal messages,
, and occasional calls.

* Learn our CRM and confidently locate project statuses, notes, documents, outstanding requirements, and next steps.

* Explain updates involving site surveys, design, permitting, utility interconnection, installation, inspections, and permission to operate.

* Identify what is holding up a project, what needs to happen next, and which team member can help.

* Gather and organize questions for operations when the CRM does not contain a complete answer.

* Track open requests and follow up until each question is answered.

* Document confirmed updates in the CRM so information remains accurate and accessible.

* Proactively communicate important changes and delays to the appropriate sales representatives.

* Clearly distinguish confirmed dates from estimates and avoid making unsupported promises.



Required Qualifications



* Substantial experience supporting residential solar projects, preferably for a U.S. solar company.

* Strong understanding of the solar project lifecycle and common reasons projects experience delays.

* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain project details clearly and professionally.

* Experience using a CRM or project management system.

* Strong organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple conversations and follow-ups.

* Confidence asking focused questions and working with different departments.

* Reliable internet, a dependable computer, and a suitable workspace.



Experience with California solar projects, battery storage, Tesla Powerwall, and solar financing milestones is a plus.



What Success Looks Like



Sales representatives receive timely, accurate answers. Outstanding questions are tracked and resolved. Operations receives organized requests with the relevant context. Project updates are easy to understand and clearly identify the next step.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your solar industry experience, including the project stages you have supported and the CRM systems you have used.

2. A brief voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your solar background.

3. Your expected monthly compensation and availability, including working hours in U.S. Pacific Time.

4. A written response to this scenario:



“A sales representative asks when their customer will receive permission to operate. The CRM shows installation is complete, final inspection is pending, and no inspection date is confirmed. What would you tell the representative, and what would you do next?”



Strong solar knowledge and clear English communication are essential for this position.

title: Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for an experienced, highly accurate and dependable Senior Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant to support multiple companies within our group.

Your primary responsibility will be Finance and Bookkeeping, ensuring our financial records are accurate, current and properly reconciled.

As part of a small cross-functional team, you will also support HR administration, compliance, contracts, legal documentation and general company administration when required.

This role requires someone who can take ownership of recurring finance workflows, identify discrepancies independently and ensure issues are resolved without repeated management follow-up.



Key Responsibilities



Finance & Bookkeeping

Maintain accurate day-to-day bookkeeping across multiple companies.

Record and correctly categorize income, expenses, accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Perform bank, payment account and balance reconciliations.

Maintain accurate general ledger records in Xero.

Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports.

Review financial records for missing entries, incorrect classifications and discrepancies.

Maintain supporting documents, invoices, receipts and financial records.

Assist with payroll preparation and employee payment records.

Coordinate financial information required by accountants, auditors, banks and other external parties.

Support inventory and purchase reconciliation with the Supply Chain team.

Maintain and improve bookkeeping SOPs, checklists and recurring finance workflows.

HR, Legal & Administration

Maintain employee records, contracts and HR documentation.

Support onboarding, offboarding and recurring HR administration.

Track important company, contract, insurance, licence and compliance deadlines.

Prepare and organize documents for management, external accountants, lawyers and other professional service providers.

Follow up on outstanding documents, signatures, filings and administrative requirements.

Support other administrative requirements across the company when needed.



What We Expect



Accuracy: Financial information must be checked before it is reported.

Ownership: If something does not reconcile or information is missing, investigate and follow through until it is resolved.

Timeliness: Monthly accounts and recurring finance tasks must stay current.

Early escalation: Raise discrepancies, cash-flow concerns, missing documents or compliance risks early.

Documentation: Records must be organized so another person can understand and verify the work.

Improvement: Identify recurring errors or inefficient processes and recommend practical improvements.



Qualifications & Skills



Minimum 2–3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Strong hands-on experience with Xero.

Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations and financial statements.

Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and financial data.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Able to work independently and manage recurring deadlines.

Good written and spoken English.

Comfortable learning new systems and using AI tools for research and administrative work.

Experience with inventory-based businesses is an advantage.

Experience with Dext, Cin7 or similar systems is an advantage.

HR or administrative experience is an advantage but not required.

Accounting or Finance qualifications are preferred, but demonstrated practical bookkeeping capability and accuracy are more important.



How Success Is Measured



Success means the company accounts remain accurate, reconciled and up to date, monthly financial information can be relied upon, outstanding issues are identified early, and management does not need to repeatedly check or chase routine Finance, HR and administrative work.

This role suits someone who is comfortable taking responsibility for accuracy and wants broader exposure beyond bookkeeping within a small company.

title: Ecommerce Video Editor (VSLS/SHORT FORM)
description:
# Expert eCommerce Direct-Response Video Editor — Meta Ads



**Remote | Full-Time or Contract**



We are a rapidly scaling eCommerce brand seeking an expert-level **Direct-Response Video Editor** to create high-converting Meta ad creatives.



This role is specifically for editors who specialize in **eCommerce VSLs and paid social advertising**. If direct-response eCommerce editing is not a core part of your daily work, this position will not be the right fit.



## Role Overview



Your primary responsibility will be editing **2–5 minute VSL-style Meta ads designed to generate purchases**.



You will also create short-form ad formats, including:



* Claymation-style creatives

* Pixar-style creatives

* Skeleton and anatomy-based creatives

* AI-generated UGC

* Product demonstrations

* Other emerging direct-response formats



Our goal is not simply to create visually appealing videos. Every creative must be built to capture attention, maintain retention, communicate value, and drive conversions.



## Direct-Response Structure



You should be experienced in editing ads built around frameworks such as:



* Problem

* Agitation

* Authority

* Discovery

* Unique mechanism

* Product introduction

* Benefits

* Social proof

* Testimonials

* Offer

* Scarcity

* Call to action



You must understand how to visually reinforce every line of a script and maintain viewer attention throughout the entire advertisement.



## Creative Style



Our preferred editing style includes:



* Documentary-style visuals

* Limited reliance on generic stock footage

* AI-generated B-roll

* AI-generated UGC

* 3D product and mechanism animations

* Dynamic captions

* Motion graphics

* Split-screen layouts

* Callouts and annotations

* Red circles, arrows, and visual emphasis

* Product proof and demonstration elements

* Fast-paced editing

* Frequent pattern interrupts

* Strategic sound design and visual effects



Problem-focused sections should feel emotional, tense, frustrating, and relatable.



Benefit-focused sections should feel aspirational, positive, hopeful, and transformational.



## AI Content Generation



You will be expected to create and incorporate AI-generated assets using tools such as:



* Freepik

* HeyGen

* Higgsfield

* Kling

* Similar AI video and image-generation platforms



You should be comfortable producing:



* AI actors

* AI-generated UGC

* AI B-roll

* AI environments

* AI product demonstrations

* Product mechanism visuals

* 3D visual explanations

* Custom scenes based on script requirements



Strong prompting skills and the ability to generate consistent, realistic assets are required.



## Responsibilities



* Edit 2–5 minute direct-response VSLs for Meta advertising

* Create multiple hook and creative variations from winning concepts

* Produce one complete VSL package per day

* Generate AI visuals and supporting assets when necessary

* Incorporate existing brand footage, product imagery, testimonials, and creative assets

* Add captions, motion graphics, sound design, visual effects, and pattern interrupts

* Rapidly implement feedback and creative revisions

* Deliver high-quality creatives consistently and on schedule

* Help improve hooks, watch time, retention, click-through rates, and conversion rates

* Maintain organized project files and creative versions



## Required Experience



You must have extensive experience with:



* eCommerce VSL editing

* Meta and
 advertising

* Direct-response marketing

* Hook development

* Retention-focused editing

* Visual storytelling

* CTA placement

* Conversion-focused creative strategy

* AI-generated content

* High-volume creative production



You must be capable of producing creatives quickly and efficiently without sacrificing quality.



## Production Expectations



For short-form content, the expected output is:



* **Four 60-second videos per day**



For VSL content, the expected output is:



* **One 3–4 minute VSL per day**

* Each VSL package should include:



 * One main body

 * Five hook variations



You must be able to meet daily deadlines and maintain consistent communication.



## Portfolio Requirements



To be considered, you must submit:



* Your portfolio

* Multiple eCommerce VSLs that you personally edited

* Examples of creatives used for Meta advertising

* Examples featuring AI-generated content

* A list of the AI tools you use

* Your typical turnaround time for a 3-5 minute VSL

* Your availability for an interview in Eastern Time



Applications without relevant eCommerce direct-response examples will not be considered.



At the very bottom of your application, include the word:



**apple**

title: IT Manager
description:
IT Manager – Job Description



Position: IT Manager

Department: Information Technology

Reports To: Operations / Senior Management

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Onsite / Hybrid, depending on business requirements



Job Summary



The IT Manager is responsible for overseeing the organization’s overall IT infrastructure, systems, cybersecurity, technical support, and IT operations. The role ensures that all technology systems are secure, reliable, efficient, and properly maintained to support day-to-day business operations.



The IT Manager will lead the IT team, manage technical projects, troubleshoot critical issues, maintain hardware and software, and work closely with Operations, HR, Recruitment, and Management to ensure that technology requirements are properly addressed.



Key Responsibilities



1. IT Infrastructure & Operations



Manage and maintain company networks, servers, workstations, internet connections, and other IT infrastructure.

Ensure reliable operation of business-critical systems and applications.

Monitor system performance and proactively identify potential technical issues.

Implement preventive maintenance and system improvement plans.

Manage IT assets, equipment, licenses, and software subscriptions.



2. Technical Support



Oversee daily IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved within appropriate timelines.

Provide escalation support for complex hardware, software, network, and system issues.

Establish an effective ticketing and support process.

Ensure employees receive proper technical assistance and guidance.



3. Cybersecurity & Data Protection



Implement and maintain IT security policies and procedures.

Monitor access controls, user permissions, endpoint security, and network security.

Ensure company systems and sensitive business information are properly protected.

Coordinate backup, recovery, and business continuity procedures.

Conduct regular security assessments and recommend improvements.



4. IT Team Leadership



Lead, supervise, and develop the IT team.

Assign tasks and monitor completion and service-level performance.

Conduct coaching, performance reviews, and technical development initiatives.

Establish clear IT procedures, standards, and accountability within the team.



5. IT Project Management



Plan and manage IT projects, including system implementations, upgrades, migrations, and infrastructure improvements.

Coordinate with vendors, service providers, and internal departments.

Manage project timelines, budgets, resources, and implementation risks.

Ensure new technology solutions are properly tested and deployed.



6. Vendor & Budget Management



Manage relationships with IT vendors, internet service providers, software providers, and technology partners.

Evaluate technology products and services based on business requirements.

Negotiate pricing, contracts, and service agreements when required.

Prepare and monitor the IT budget and recommend cost-effective solutions.



7. Business & Operations Support



Work closely with Operations and Management to identify technology requirements.

Ensure IT systems can support business growth and operational demands.

Assist in the setup of technology requirements for new employees, teams, and projects.

Provide technical recommendations to management for improving productivity and operational efficiency.



Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

3–5+ years of experience in IT, with previous experience in an IT supervisory or management position preferred.

Strong knowledge of computer hardware, networking, operating systems, and business applications.

Experience managing IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, backups, and user access.

Experience leading or supervising an IT team.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Experience managing IT vendors, projects, and budgets is an advantage.

Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills.

Ability to work under pressure and respond effectively to urgent technical issues.



Preferred Technical Skills

Network administration and troubleshooting

Windows/Linux environments

LAN/WAN, routers, switches, Wi-Fi, and VPN

Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration

Hardware and endpoint management

Cybersecurity and access management

Data backup and disaster recovery

IT asset management

Cloud services and system administration

Helpdesk/ticketing systems

Basic knowledge of virtualization and server management

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

IT system uptime and reliability

Average IT issue resolution time

Ticket resolution and response rate

Network and infrastructure performance

Security incidents and compliance

Successful completion of IT projects

IT budget adherence

Asset and license management accuracy

Employee satisfaction with IT support

Backup and disaster recovery readiness

Ideal Candidate



The ideal IT Manager is a hands-on technology leader who can balance technical expertise with management responsibilities. They should be proactive, organized, dependable, and capable of making sound technical decisions while understanding the operational needs of the business. They should also be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where system availability, data security, and quick technical support are critical to business continuity.

Social Media • Beauty • Fashion • Lead Generation • Websites • GoHighLevel • Content • Digital Operations

CONTENT CREATION + PHOTO/VIDEO EDITING

title: Part-Time B2B Cold Caller and Appointment Setter – Coffee & Healthy Vending Services
description:
Conscious Fuel is a Los Angeles-based company providing office coffee, healthy snacks, vending and workplace refreshment services.



We are looking for an experienced, friendly and highly organized appointment setter to make approximately 50 calls to local businesses over 3–5 business days.



This is a small paid trial project with the possibility of ongoing weekly work for the right person.



YOUR PRIMARY GOAL



Speak with an office manager, facilities manager, operations manager or workplace-experience manager and schedule a short, in-person introduction with the owner of Conscious Fuel.



You are not expected to close the sale. Your job is to create a friendly conversation, determine whether the company may need coffee or vending services and book a qualified appointment.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Make approximately 50 outbound B2B calls

- Work during Los Angeles/Pacific business hours

- Ask for the appropriate workplace decision-maker

- Follow our call guide while sounding natural and conversational

- Explain Conscious Fuel’s coffee, healthy-snack and vending services

- Schedule qualified in-person appointments

- Send brief follow-up
s when appropriate

- Record every call and result in our CRM or Google Sheet

- Clearly document interested prospects, objections and follow-up dates

- Provide a brief end-of-day progress report



YOU MUST HAVE



- Excellent spoken and written English

- A clear, friendly and easily understood speaking voice

- Previous B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

- Experience calling businesses in the United States

- A warm, personable and professional phone manner

- The ability to get past gatekeepers respectfully

- Strong listening and objection-handling skills

- Experience using a CRM, Google Sheets and online calendars

- A reliable computer, quality headset and stable high-speed internet

- A quiet, professional calling environment

- A dependable calling and follow-up system

- Availability during Pacific Time business hours



Experience calling office managers, facilities managers, property managers, schools, nonprofits, medical offices or professional workplaces is strongly preferred.



COMPENSATION



- $6 USD per hour

- Approximately 6–8 hours for the initial project

- $10 bonus for every qualified appointment booked

- Paid training and practice-call time

- Opportunity for ongoing weekly work if the trial is successful



A qualified appointment must be with a person who helps make decisions about office coffee, employee snacks, vending or workplace refreshments and who has agreed to an in-person meeting.



TO APPLY, PLEASE PROVIDE



1. A 60–90 second voice or video introduction.

2. A description of your B2B cold-calling experience.

3. The number of calls and appointments you typically complete.

4. The calling system, CRM and scheduling tools you have used.

5. Your internet speed and backup plan for internet or power outages.

6. Your availability during Pacific Time business hours.

7. A brief example of how you would respond if a receptionist says, “We’re not interested.”



Please begin your application with the words “Healthy Coffee” so we know you read the entire posting.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid practice-call session before being selected.

title: Executive Assistant - Work From Home
description:
We're after a proactive, experienced Executive Assistant to join our team, supporting a busy executive in the project management and construction advisory space. Think fast-moving projects, developments, and compliance-heavy work, so you'll need to enjoy staying on top of a lot of moving parts.



About the Role



This is a true executive support role. You'll take ownership of the executive's calendar, inbox and day-to-day, keeping them organised, prepared, and ahead of what's coming. Your job is to make sure the important things get done, the right things get their attention, and nothing slips through the cracks.



You'll own their calendar and inbox, get on top of a busy
 backlog, and prepare a daily briefing so they can walk into each day already knowing what's ahead. This is a role for someone who gets ahead of their executive, not someone who waits to be told.



The role starts at around 20 hours a week (roughly 4 hours a day) and is designed to build towards full-time as things settle and you take on more.



What You'll Be Doing

- Owning the calendar — handling and scheduling meeting requests, protecting their time, keeping the week free of clashes, and making sure they always know what's next.

- Managing the inbox and clearing the backlog — working through a busy inbox, getting it under control and keeping it there, flagging what's urgent, drafting and sending replies, and clearing the noise so they only see what actually needs them.

- Preparing a daily briefing — a clear, forward-looking summary of what's ahead so they can prep: meetings, what needs organising, priorities, anything waiting on third parties, and who needs to be contacted. When you prepare it, flag the items you can take on yourself, or, even better, ones you've already actioned.

- Standard EA support — the general day-to-day that keeps a busy executive organised: scheduling and follow-ups, light research, document and file organisation, basic invoice and expense wrangling, and quietly introducing simple systems that keep things running.

- Keeping things on track — staying across what's on, what's due, and what's late, and reminding them before anything slips.



You'll be working in Microsoft 365 (Outlook / Office 365), with delegate access to the mailbox and calendar.



Hours

This is roughly 4 hours a day, and how you organise your time is up to you, as long as the work lands reliably and you overlap with New Zealand business hours for communication. The daily briefing simply needs to be fresh and ready for the start of the executive's day.



What We're Looking For (Must-Haves)

- At least 5 years' experience as an Executive Assistant supporting an executive directly, not general admin or customer service.

- Strong inbox and calendar management — you can triage, prioritise, clear a backlog, and make good judgement calls about what matters without being told.

- A proactive, anticipatory style — you get ahead of your executive, spot what's coming, and can build a clear, forward-looking briefing rather than only reacting.

- Excellent written English — you'll be drafting
 on the executive's behalf and writing the daily briefing, so your writing needs to be clear, scannable, warm, and accurate.

- Basic financial literacy — comfortable with numbers, budgets, and invoices at a basic level.

- Microsoft 365 / Outlook experience, ideally including delegate access to a mailbox and calendar.

- Reliable overlap with NZ business hours for communication.



Nice to Have

- Experience supporting a project management, construction, engineering, or professional services business

- Experience supporting New Zealand or Australian executives

- A knack for quietly introducing light systems that keep a busy person organised



We're looking forward to hearing from you.

title: SEO Specialist (WordPress & Shopify / Part-Time Trial to Long-Term)
description:
Do you want to be a core part of building up our digital marketing agency? How about having the opportunity to grow your expertise across multi-platform client sites, with a clear path toward a long-term, stable collaboration? If your answers are yes, please read on.



As our SEO Specialist, you will help our diverse clients (covering WordPress business websites and Shopify e-commerce stores) scale their organic visibility, traffic, and lead generation. In the AI era, we go beyond traditional rankings to focus heavily on AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and AI search visibility.



Our ideal candidate is organized, self-motivated, analytical, and detail-oriented. You will work closely with our internal WordPress Website Designer to implement changes seamlessly. You will NOT have to deal with clients directly; your sole focus is on technical excellence, execution, and content strategy. 



Candidates residing outside of Manila (Provincial/Regional areas in the Philippines) are strongly encouraged to apply.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Trial Phase Focus: You will initially handle 2-3 client websites (WordPress & Shopify), with performance and progress reviewed on a weekly basis.

- Comprehensive Audits & Strategy: Conduct SEO audits for client sites and deliver actionable, step-by-step optimization plans.

- Keyword & AI-Era Planning: Perform advanced keyword research, search intent mapping, competitor gap analysis, and AI-era content planning.

- WordPress & Shopify Optimization: 

- WordPress: Handle technical architecture, Core Web Vitals, speed optimization, and on-page execution.

- Shopify: Overcome technical SEO limits (URL structures, metadata, collection/product page architecture), and fix duplicate content or canonical issues.

- Content Marketing & Modern SEO: 

- Independently write high-quality blog posts and content marketing pieces, and directly log into the WordPress backend to publish, format, and configure basic SEO settings.

- Plan image and multimedia SEO strategies.

- Deploy JSON-LD structured data (Product, Article, Organization, etc.) to enhance visibility in both AI and traditional search engines.

- Collaboration: Provide precise, clear on-page optimization guidelines (meta tags, h-tags, internal linking) for our WordPress Website Designer to implement efficiently.



KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, EXPERIENCE NEEDED:

- Proven hands-on SEO experience, preferably within a digital marketing agency environment.

- Must have direct, hands-on experience with both WordPress and Shopify SEO, including publishing content directly in the WP backend.

- Solid understanding of AEO / GEO (AI search optimization) and how content is parsed by AI engines.

- Familiarity with standard SEO and analytics tools (Ahrefs/Semrush, GSC, GA4, Screaming Frog).

- Excellent English writing and content creation skills, with strong expertise in keyword integration and JSON-LD structured data.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet home office setup for remote work.



COMPENSATION & TRIAL STRUCTURE:

- Structure: 1-Month Part-Time Trial to start. You will manage 2-3 client websites and we will review your performance metrics weekly.

- Compensation: $150 USD for the 1-month trial period (approx. 10-15 hours per week).

- Growth Potential: If your work proves effective and drives measurable results during the 1-month trial, this will seamlessly transition into a long-term, stable monthly collaboration with increased scope and pay.

- Payment: Paid securely in USD via global transfer (compatible with local Philippine banks).



HOW TO APPLY:

If you are excited about growing with our team, please reply with:

1. A brief introduction about yourself and your current province/city (outside Manila).

2. Examples or case studies of past WordPress/Shopify SEO projects, specifically highlighting technical optimization, blog writing, or structured data implementation.

3. Confirmation that you accept the 1-month part-time trial structure ($150 for the first month, managing 2-3 sites with weekly reviews).
