title: Senior Medical & Dental Billing Specialist — Oral Surgery
description:
Remote — Philippines | Part-time | $8–12 USD/hour, depending on experience



We’re looking for an experienced U.S. medical billing specialist to help handle medical and dental billing for oral & maxillofacial surgery practices.



We need someone who understands the full lifecycle of a medical claim and can independently work through difficult claims from submission to payment.



The role will start at 8 hours/week, with the opportunity to increase hours over time as we add practices.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Verify medical and dental insurance eligibility and benefits.

• Determine whether procedures can appropriately be billed to medical insurance.

• Review clinical notes and supporting documentation for medical necessity.

• Identify appropriate ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and CDT codes.

• Cross-code dental procedures to medical when appropriate.

• Prepare and submit medical and dental claims.

• Obtain prior authorizations when required.

• Attach clinical documentation, narratives, imaging, and other supporting material.

• Track claims through adjudication.

• Investigate rejected and denied claims; submit corrected claims and appeals.

• Interpret EOBs and ERAs; post payments and adjustments.

• Follow up on outstanding insurance A/R and call U.S. insurance companies when needed.

• Coordinate medical and dental insurance when both are involved.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• 3+ years of hands-on, full-cycle U.S. medical billing experience.

• Experience personally working claims from eligibility through payment.

• Strong knowledge of ICD-10 and CPT/HCPCS.

• Experience with denials, appeals, insurance A/R, and clinical documentation supporting claims.

• Experience working directly with U.S. commercial insurance companies.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.

• Based in the Philippines, with a reliable setup for remote work.



Payment posting alone does not count as full-cycle billing experience.



STRONGLY PREFERRED



• Oral & maxillofacial surgery (OMS) and dental billing experience.

• CDT coding and dental-to-medical cross-coding.

• Medical billing for oral surgery procedures such as wisdom teeth, anesthesia, pathology, trauma, TMJ, sleep apnea, or implants, where coverage and medical necessity support billing.

• Coordination between medical and dental benefits.

• Surgical specialties such as ENT, plastics, anesthesia, or ambulatory surgery.

• Open Dental, WinOMS, OMSVision, Dentrix, or similar practice-management software.



If you have worked directly inside an OMS practice handling both medical and dental billing, we especially want to hear from you. Strong full-cycle medical billing expertise is required; OMS/dental experience is strongly preferred.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a U.S.-based startup building a new billing service for oral surgery practices.



Initially, this role will be very hands-on: reviewing cases, submitting claims, following them through payment, and solving problems when claims are denied.



You’ll also work directly with the founder to document how the work is done and improve the systems and tools used to perform it. We’re looking for someone who can bring real medical billing expertise and work independently.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



• $8–12 USD/hour, depending on experience.

• 8 hours/week initially, with the opportunity to increase hours over time as we add practices.

• Remote, Philippines-based.

• Flexible schedule, with some overlap with U.S. business hours for payer calls.

• Opportunity for significantly more hours and responsibility over time.



TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions. Specific answers are much more valuable than a long cover letter. Please use only anonymized examples and do not include patient-identifying information.



1. How many years have you personally done full-cycle U.S. medical billing? What specialties have you billed for?

2. Have you worked for an oral surgery, dental, ENT, anesthesia, plastic surgery, or other surgical practice? Describe your experience.

3. Have you personally handled both medical and dental billing? If yes, describe an anonymized case where both medical and dental insurance were involved.

4. Which coding systems have you personally worked with—ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and CDT? Explain your level of experience with each.

5. Tell us about a difficult denied medical claim that you successfully got paid. What was wrong with the claim, and what did you do?

6. Scenario: An oral surgeon extracts four impacted wisdom teeth under IV sedation. How would you determine whether any portion of the procedure should be submitted to the patient’s medical insurance? Walk us through your process.

7. Which billing or practice-management systems have you used?

8. What hourly rate are you looking for, how many hours per week are you currently available, and what overlap can you offer with U.S. business hours?



We will discuss your answers during the interview, so please answer based on your own experience.

title: Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist — Shopify Jewelry Brand (Account Rebuild + Flows)
description:
## JOB TYPE

Part-time (20 hrs/week) — with the option to move to full-time based on performance



**About us**



Nolters Gold is a US-based e-commerce brand selling 10K and 14K solid gold jewelry. We've been in business for four years and sell through Shopify (
), Etsy, and eBay. We are a small, fast-moving remote team, and we already work with several Philippines-based specialists.



**What this role is**



This is not a "send a newsletter every week" role. Our Klaviyo account has been dormant since 2024, and we need someone to rebuild it properly from the ground up and then run it.



Phase 1 is a rebuild project (roughly 4–6 weeks). Phase 2 is ongoing management of the channel. We are hiring one person for both.



**Phase 1 — Account rebuild**



- Audit the existing Klaviyo account: old flows, forms, lists, and segments. Recommend what to keep, fix, or delete.

- Re-enable and verify the Shopify integration, confirm order history and Placed Order events are syncing correctly.

- Clean and segment the contact list. A portion of our contacts were manually imported from Etsy and have no purchase events attached — these need to be identified and handled separately.

- Verify and repair sending infrastructure: dedicated sending domain, DKIM, SPF, and DMARC.

- Plan and execute a re-engagement and warm-up sequence so we can start sending to a two-year-dormant list without damaging our domain reputation. This is the single most important part of the job.

- Build our core flow suite: welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, and win-back. Abandoned cart is our first priority.

- Build on-site signup forms and a popup that matches our brand.



**Phase 2 — Ongoing management**



- Plan and send a monthly campaign calendar (promotions, new product launches, seasonal).

- Write email copy and build emails in Klaviyo's editor using our product photography.

- Maintain segmentation and suppression lists; monitor list health.

- A/B test subject lines, send times, and offers.

- Report monthly on flow revenue, campaign revenue, open/click/conversion rates, deliverability, and list growth.



---



## REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE



- Minimum 2 years of hands-on Klaviyo experience with Shopify e-commerce brands. This is a hard requirement — please do not apply if your experience is mainly Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, or general VA work.

- Proven experience with email deliverability: sending domain setup, DKIM/SPF/DMARC, sender reputation repair, and list warming.

- Experience reviving or cleaning up a neglected or dormant email list.

- Strong written English. You will be writing customer-facing copy for a US audience.

- Comfortable building emails that look good on mobile, working from existing brand photography.

- Able to read Klaviyo analytics and explain what the numbers mean in plain language.

- Reliable and self-directed. We will give you clear goals, not step-by-step instructions.



**Nice to have**



- Klaviyo certifications (Product, Deliverability, or Marketing Automation)

- Experience with jewelry, luxury, or other high-average-order-value products

- SMS marketing experience in Klaviyo

- Basic HTML/CSS for email



---



## WORK ARRANGEMENT



- Fully remote

- Flexible hours, but you must have at least 3 hours of daily overlap with Pacific Time (Los Angeles) business hours

- Hours are tracked with TimeDoctor

- Paid twice monthly via Wise, on approximately the 1st and the 16th

- We will ask you to complete a W-8BEN form for US tax compliance



---



## HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip any of these steps will not be reviewed.



1. Put **GOLD-KLAVIYO** at the start of your application subject line.

2. Answer these three questions directly in your application:

 - Our Klaviyo list has not been emailed since 2024. Walk us through exactly how you would start sending to it again without damaging our sender reputation. Be specific about sequence and segmentation.

 - Some of our contacts were manually copied from Etsy orders into Klaviyo, so they have no Placed Order event and unclear marketing consent. How would you handle them?

 - What was the flow revenue percentage (flow revenue as a share of total store revenue) on the last Klaviyo account you managed, and how long did it take you to get there?

3. Attach one screenshot of a Klaviyo dashboard or flow report from an account you personally built or managed. Blur the client name if you need to.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short paid test task before we make an offer.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
About Us

At ProfitWorks, we genuinely believe that our people are the heart of everything we do. We’ve focused on building a workplace that feels less like a corporate machine and more like a community, creating a space where you’re supported, heard, and actually excited to grow. We aren't big on empty promises and prefer to let our history speak for itself. We’re incredibly proud that two of our tea
mbers have been with our founder for 13 years, while many others are nearing their 6th anniversary. It’s a steady, welcoming environment where people don’t just pass through, they stay and thrive.



At ProfitWorks, we make sure our contractors can focus on what they do best by providing the security, support, and balance you deserve. To back that up, we offer a generous package including 80–120 hours of PTO, 7 paid holidays, 13th-month payroll, and life insurance up to ?100,000. Your well-being is a top priority, so we cover a paid Philippine HMO & Dental plan, your Annual Physical Exam (APE), mental health consultation reimbursements (up to ?20,000/year), and SSS, PhilHealth, or Pag-IBIG reimbursements.



Beyond financial and health security, we invest directly in your career through a comprehensive, fully compensated onboarding program, clear performance goals with advancement compensation, and opportunities for advancement after proof of mastery. If you’re looking for a team that prioritizes real connections, long-term stability, and continuous support, we’d love to hear from you. Come say hi and see if ProfitWorks is the right fit for you!



Role Overview



The Client Success Manager (CSM) serves as a vital strategic pillar bridging client relationship management, end-to-end talent acquisition, and operational service delivery. Working in close alignment with the CEO, the CSM translates company vision into actionable operational and growth strategies. The CSM takes full accountability for managing the entire client lifecycle—from identifying high-value prospects, conducting initial discovery calls, and crafting tailored proposals, to overseeing offshore candidate screening, recruitment, and seamless onboarding. 



Beyond initial integration, the CSM acts as the primary client liaison, proactively managing client concerns, leading cross-functional teams (including Recruitment, HR, and Operations), and enforcing service quality through continuous performance monitoring, daily End-of-Shift reporting, and KPI tracking. By combining strategic workforce planning with hands-on process optimization, the CSM ensures exceptional service delivery, drives long-term client retention, and unlocks sustainable account growth across ProfitWorks' accounting and staffing solutions. 





Key Responsibilities



1. Client Engagement, Relationship & Account Growth

Lead discovery calls and business development conversations with prospects to understand hiring, accounting, and operational requirements.

Manage the full client journey, acting as the primary point of contact for all client inquiries, feedback, and strategic account planning.

Foster long-term relationships and drive client retention through proactive communication, regular workforce alignment, and exceptional service delivery.

Support proposal development, agreement management, and account expansion opportunities with existing U.S. clients.



2. End-to-End Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

Partner directly with clients to define staffing needs, draft custom job profiles, and establish recruitment timelines.

Oversee recruitment and candidate screening workflows alongside internal sourcing teams to match top-tier offshore talent to client requirements.

Facilitate seamless onboarding, system integration, and task handoffs between clients and placed offshore contractors.



3. Performance Monitoring, Quality Assurance & Operations

Establish, track, and analyze client and team KPIs, daily reports, and End-of-Shift summaries to evaluate performance.

Proactively identify operational bottlenecks, performance gaps, or service friction points, delivering data-driven solutions and process improvements.

Utilize project management tools (e.g., ClickUp, HubStaff, Time Doctor) to manage workload distribution, task execution, and team productivity.



4. Cross-Functional Team Leadership & Coordination

Collaborate closely across internal units—including Recruitment, HR, Operations, and Virtual Support teams—to ensure complete alignment with client expectations.

Lead internal syncs and alignment meetings to streamline communication, share feedback, and resolve challenges.

Provide coaching, support, and guidance to tea
mbers to maintain high service quality and continuous professional growth.





What We’re Looking For



Experience & Expertise

Experience: 3–5+ years in Account Management, Client Success, Operations Management, or offshore talent delivery.

U.S. Market Experience: Demonstrated background working directly with U.S.-based business owners, executives, or offshore staffing models.

Domain Context: Prior exposure to accounting/finance, construction, home services, mortgage, or non-tech client services is a strong advantage.



Skills & Tool Proficiency



Project & Ops Management: Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Time Doctor, Google Workspace, and MS Office.

Recruitment & Sourcing: Solid grasp of end-to-end recruitment pipelines, candidate screening, and workforce planning.

Communication: Superior written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence leading client presentations and discovery calls.

Strategic & Critical Thinking: Able to analyze complex client requirements, design scalable operational frameworks, and resolve problems independently.



Why You Will Love Working Here

Supportive Team & Mentorship: Work alongside a collaborative, growth-oriented team with clear guidance from implementation leadership.

Continuous Learning: Deepen your expertise daily with cutting-edge AI tools, automation platforms, and complex integration projects.

Career Growth: Real opportunity to progressively step into larger implementation, governance, and systems responsibilities over time.

Flexible Remote Work: 100% remote setup within a highly collaborative US-Philippines hybrid working environment.

Real Impact: Your work directly dictates how efficiently and successfully our business scales.



Perks: 

80-120 Hours of PTO 

 7 Paid Holidays 

 13th Month Payroll 

 Life insurance of up to Php100,000

 Paid Philippine HMO & Dental plan 

 Paid Annual Physical Exam (APE)

 Mental Health Consultation Reimbursement up to ?20,000/year (capped at ?2,000 per session for up to 10 sessions)

 Social Security System Reimbursement

 PhilHealth or PagIbig Reimbursement

Comprehensive, fully compensated onboarding program 

Advancement after Proof of Mastery 

Performance Goals with advancement compensation 





We can’t wait to meet you and discover the value you’ll bring to our team! If this sounds like a role you’re excited about, apply now and help us continue building a workplace we all love.

title: Part-Time Business Attorney for Three Small Businesses
description:
Hi, I’m Timo. I run a gardening business, I’m launching an elder mobility company, and I’m building a media company. I’m looking for a U.S.-licensed business attorney who can get to know these businesses and be someone I can turn to as questions and opportunities come up.



I’d like to start with a part-time retainer relationship that could grow along with the businesses. Right now, I’m looking for help reviewing our business registrations and organizational documents, drafting and reviewing agreements, and making sure we’re addressing the legal issues that come with operating and growing each company.



I work closely with business partners and other professionals, so I’d value an attorney who is practical, responsive, and comfortable explaining the options in plain language. I’m looking for an ongoing relationship with someone who understands what I’m building.



If you’re interested, please send me a little about your experience with small businesses, your state or states of licensure, your availability, and your proposed retainer structure and rates. I’d also love to hear how you typically work with clients on an ongoing basis.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Tax Professional for Three Small Businesses
description:
Hi, I’m Timo. I run a gardening business, I’m launching an elder mobility company, and I’m building a media company. I’m looking for someone who can get to know all three businesses and help me stay on top of their finances as they grow.



This would start as a part-time retainer relationship, with the potential to become a larger role over time.



I’m looking for help with bookkeeping for each business, payroll, client billing, payment tracking, account reconciliation, monthly financial reports, and tax preparation. I’d also appreciate someone who can help put straightforward systems in place so I have a clear picture of where each business stands.



I’m open to working with a bookkeeper, accountant, CPA, enrolled agent, or small firm. If you don’t prepare tax returns yourself, that’s okay—please let me know how you typically coordinate with a tax professional.



If this sounds like a fit, please send me a little about your experience with U.S. small businesses, the services you offer, your availability, and your proposed retainer structure and rates. I’d also love to know what working with you month to month would look like.

title: AI Content Operator & Video Editor (Short-Form / Growth-Focused)
description:
We run a fast-growing online health company helping people get out of pain and move better without relying on traditional healthcare. We create a lot of content (short-form videos, ads, educational content), and we’re looking for someone who can help us turn 1 video into 10–30 high-performing pieces of content using AI.



This is NOT a basic video editing job. This is NOT just dropping a video into OpusClip (or other similar tool).

We are looking for someone who understands content, attention, and performance. Great English communication is required.



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

Take raw video footage and turn it into:

- Short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)

- Editing Long form videos (youtube)

- Adding AI b-roll or creating AI generated videos based on a script. 

- Ad creatives

- Create multiple variations of the same content (different hooks, captions, pacing)



Use AI tools to:

- Rewrite hooks and scripts

- Generate new content ideas

- Add captions, fast cuts, zooms, and edits that improve retention



TOOLS YOU SHOULD BE FAMILIAR WITH:

- Descript

- CapCut/Premiere Pro/Final Cut

- Claude/ChatGPT or similar for scripting + ideation

- HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana, Opus, or AI content tools



THIS JOB IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

- You don’t use AI tools regularly

- You only know how to edit but don’t understand content performance

- You need step-by-step instructions for everything

- You focus on making things “look pretty” instead of performing well



THIS JOB IS FOR YOU IF:

- You enjoy breaking down viral videos and recreating them

- You like testing different hooks and ideas

- You want to grow with a company long-term

- You’re excited about AI and using it to work faster and smarter



If you're interested, add the words, Orange Cactus, to the end of your email.



Hope to hear from you!

title: Administrative & Operations Assistant – Client Account Support
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Position | U.S. Eastern Time

Willoway Consulting & Management LLC is a growing consulting and management company that provides administrative, operational, and business management support to small businesses.



We are seeking a dependable, organized, and professional Administrative & Operations Assistant to become an important part of our team.



Your initial primary assignment will be supporting the day-to-day administrative and operational needs of an established HVAC company located in Florida. Because of this, experience in HVAC, home services, field-service operations, scheduling, dispatching, or similar environments is highly valued.



This is not a temporary position. We are looking for someone who wants to learn our processes, take ownership of their responsibilities, and grow with Willoway long-term.



As our company grows, this position may also have opportunities to support additional Willoway client accounts based on business needs, workload, and the team member's demonstrated skills and experience.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, communicates professionally, follows instructions well, takes initiative, and can manage multiple tasks without needing constant supervision.



Work Schedule

Monday–Friday

8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Candidates must be comfortable working these hours consistently from the Philippines.



Primary Responsibilities

Your initial responsibilities will primarily support our HVAC client account and include:

• Monitor and respond to customer
s and messages

• Assist with incoming customer inquiries

• Schedule and reschedule HVAC service appointments

• Maintain technician schedules and assist with dispatch coordination

• Create and update customers and jobs in Jobber

• Enter service notes and maintain accurate customer records

• Send appointment confirmations and follow-ups

• Prepare and send estimates and invoices based on information provided by management

• Follow up on outstanding estimates

• Follow up on unpaid invoices and customer deposits

• Assist with maintenance agreement scheduling and tracking

• Communicate with vendors regarding equipment, parts, orders, and ETAs

• Track permits and inspections

• Organize customer documents, photographs, receipts, invoices, and service records

• Assist with warranty documentation and follow-up

• Maintain administrative task lists and follow-up items

• Prepare daily updates for management

• Escalate customer or operational issues requiring management attention

• Perform other administrative and client-support duties as needed



Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• Has excellent written and spoken English

• Communicates professionally with customers and clients

• Is highly organized and detail-oriented

• Is comfortable speaking with customers and vendors

• Can manage multiple priorities

• Is dependable and punctual

• Can follow established procedures

• Is comfortable asking questions when clarification is necessary

• Can work independently after training

• Has strong computer and internet skills

• Is comfortable learning new software

• Understands the importance of accurate documentation

• Can maintain confidentiality regarding Willoway, our clients, and their customers

• Understands the importance of representing our company and our clients professionally



Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is highly preferred:

• HVAC companies

• Plumbing, electrical, construction, or other home-service businesses

• Field-service operations

• Jobber

• ServiceTitan

• Housecall Pro

• QuickBooks

• Google Workspace

• Customer service

• Dispatching

• Scheduling

• Accounts receivable

• Estimates and invoicing

• Permit/inspection coordination



Previous HVAC experience is preferred but not required for an exceptional candidate who is willing and able to learn.



What We're Looking for Personally

•	We don't expect you to know everything on your first day.

•	We do expect you to be teachable, dependable, honest, organized, and willing to take ownership of your responsibilities.

•	We especially value someone who notices when something needs attention and takes appropriate action rather than  waiting to be reminded repeatedly.

•	Because you will be supporting one of our client accounts, professionalism, discretion, good judgment, and the ability to represent Willoway and our clients well are extremely important.

•	Attention to detail is essential in this position.





Technology Requirements

You must have:

• Reliable high-speed internet

• Reliable computer

• Quiet professional workspace

• Headset suitable for customer/vendor calls

• Backup plan for internet or power interruptions

• Ability to participate in video meetings when necessary



Training

Training will be provided on Willoway's procedures, client-specific procedures, and the systems required for the position.

Initially, you will work closely with management to learn the HVAC client's scheduling, customer communication, Jobber workflows, invoicing, estimating, documentation, follow-up procedures, and general administrative operations.



As you demonstrate competency, you will be given greater responsibility and ownership of the client's daily administrative operations.



Additional training may be provided as you are introduced to other Willoway client accounts or responsibilities.



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. A brief introduction about yourself and your administrative experience.



2. Describe any experience you have working with an HVAC, plumbing, electrical, construction, property management, or other service-based company.



3. If you've used Jobber in a previous role, tell us how you used it and approximately how long you worked with the platform. You may also include experience with ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, QuickBooks, or similar software.



4. Describe your experience communicating directly with U.S.-based customers by phone,
, and/or text.



5. Confirm that you are available to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.



6. Describe your internet and power backup arrangements.



7. Tell us about a position where you were responsible for managing several different tasks at the same time.



8. Tell us what you do when you receive a task but aren't sure how to complete it.



Attention-to-detail instruction: At the very bottom of your application, write the words "Willoway Support" followed by your favorite number.



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.

We are looking to hire promptly and begin training immediately.

title: Live Commerce Host
description:
Job description:



Why Join Us?



At Organica, we are redefining how people shop for wellness. As our Live Commerce Host, you are the voice, face, and energy of our brand. You’ll have the platform to build a community and drive real-time impact in the fast-growing world of social commerce.



Job Purpose



The Live Commerce Host drives online sales through engaging live selling sessions on e-commerce platforms like TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Lazada. They present products clearly, highlight benefits, and manage real-time customer interactions to boost conversion and brand awareness. The role involves preparing content, executing promos, optimizing engagement, and tracking performance, while collaborating closely with e-commerce, marketing, and fulfillment teams. Hosts stay up to date with live commerce trends, adapt quickly to platform features, and maintain a professional, energetic on-screen presence to ensure a seamless and sales-driven live experience.



Job Responsibilities



Live Selling Strategy: Plan and host Live Selling sessions that support sales targets and campaign goals. Understand product positioning, pricing, and promo mechanics before each live.

Product and Content Management: Present products clearly, demonstrate usage, and highlight benefits. Ensure accurate product information, pricing, and stock availability during Live sessions.

Sales and Engagement Optimization: Use selling techniques such as limited offers, bundles, and urgency to increase conversion. Encourage interaction through questions, polls, and shout-outs.

Customer Experience Enhancement: Respond to customer questions and concerns in real time. Handle objections professionally and create a fun and welcoming live environment.

Performance Tracking and Improvement: Review Live session results and identify what worked and what can be improved. Apply learnings to future Live Selling sessions.

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the e-commerce, marketing, and fulfillment teams to align on promos, inventory, and campaign schedules. Coordinate with creatives for visuals and scripts.

Market Awareness: Stay updated on Live Commerce trends, platform features, and competitor activities. Adapt hosting style and content based on market behavior.

Job Requirements



Education: High school graduate or equivalent.

Location: Must be based within Metro Manila.

Working Hours: Should be flexible within the day (onsite work every day).

Experience: At least 2 years of live selling experience, with experience selling beauty, wellness, or health products through Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop.

Presence: Naturally confident, high-energy, and comfortable being the face of the brand in front of a live camera.

Platform Knowledge: Solid understanding of TikTok Shop Live and other live-selling platforms.

Skills: Good communication skills, time and energy management, basic technical skills, data awareness, platform familiarity, and customer engagement.

Contract Requirement: Candidates must be willing to start under an initial 1-month contract. Upon satisfactory performance and successful completion of the initial contract period, there may be an opportunity for a longer-term contract, subject to company requirements and performance evaluation.

Benefits



1% GMV Commission

Variable Bonuses

13th Month Pay

Other Supplementary Benefit

title: Bookkeeper, E-commerce & Multi-Channel (Shopify, Amazon)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Do you have hands-on experience keeping the books for a direct-to-consumer (DTC) or e-commerce brand selling across multiple channels?



We are looking for an experienced bookkeeper to manage accounting across three companies in QuickBooks Online. You should understand how an online customer order flows from gross sales through discounts, fees, refunds, chargebacks, and platform payouts to the final bank deposit.



This position requires at least 2 years of direct bookkeeping experience supporting a DTC or e-commerce business across multiple sales channels. General bookkeeping experience alone will not meet the requirements for this role.



You will keep the books accurate, current, and ready for leadership review. You will also reconcile historical receipts, invoices, and transactions from August 2025 through January 2026 as part of your ongoing workload, with no fixed catch-up deadline.



We value someone who works independently, investigates discrepancies, communicates proactively, and handles confidential financial information with discretion and integrity.



REQUIRED DTC / E-COMMERCE EXPERIENCE



To qualify, you must have:



At least 3 years of bookkeeping experience, including 2 years supporting a DTC or e-commerce business.

Hands-on experience reconciling sales and payouts across multiple channels simultaneously, beyond Shopify alone.

Experience with at least 2 of the following: Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Marketplace, Faire, TikTok Shop, Stripe, or PayPal.

The ability to separate gross sales, fees, refunds, chargebacks, sales tax, and holds or reserves, and reconcile net payouts to bank deposits.

Experience investigating payout discrepancies using platform reports, transaction details, and bank records.

Experience cleaning up historical or backlogged books.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



DTC / E-commerce Reconciliation



Reconcile sales across 6 or more sales channels and payment processors, including Shopify and marketplaces.

Accurately record sales, fees, refunds, chargebacks, and payouts, and match settlements to bank deposits.

Investigate discrepancies between platform reports, QuickBooks Online, and bank records.

Keep transactions and balances separate for each legal entity.



Bookkeeping & Historical Cleanup



Maintain accurate books across three companies, keeping each company’s records in its separate QuickBooks Online company file.

Review, verify, and categorize automated bank feed transactions.

Upload and categorize receipts, invoices, and supporting documents.

Perform weekly reconciliation checks across 7 or more bank and credit card accounts, and complete monthly statement reconciliations.

Reconcile 
 vendor bills, invoices, and payments.

Maintain the general ledger and independently prepare journal entries for accruals, adjustments, and corrections.

Reconcile historical transactions and supporting records from August 2025 through January 2026.



Financial Reporting & Leadership Support



Prepare and review weekly QuickBooks Online reports, including Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and General Ledger.

Provide brief commentary explaining significant variances, unusual transactions, and discrepancies.

Maintain budget spreadsheets and flag differences between budgeted and actual results.

Monitor balance sheet accuracy, cash flow trends, cost increases, and margin changes.

Communicate issues proactively and follow through on resolving them.



ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS



Strong QuickBooks Online expertise, including native bank feed connections.

Experience using 
 for invoices, bills, and payments.

Strong understanding of financial statements, the general ledger, and journal entries.

Ability to manage bookkeeping across multiple companies without mixing transactions or records.

High attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

Confidence communicating findings and questions directly to leadership.

Discretion and integrity when handling confidential financial information.

Familiarity with tools such as Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, Stripe, PayPal, and Ramp.



HOW TO APPLY — REQUIRED



Please include both of the following:



1. A link to your resume



Your resume should clearly identify your DTC or e-commerce bookkeeping experience and the platforms you have worked with. Please make sure the link is accessible.



2. Your answers to the application assessment below



For Questions 1 and 3, begin with Yes or No, then explain your answer. For Question 2, select one answer.



Specific examples from your own work are encouraged. Please do not share confidential client information.



APPLICATION ASSESSMENT



1. E-commerce bookkeeping experience



Have you managed bookkeeping for a DTC or e-commerce business?



If yes, please describe:



Which sales channels or platforms you worked with, such as Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, wholesale, or similar.

Roughly how many transactions or how much monthly revenue you reconciled across those channels.

How you reconciled sales, fees, refunds, and payouts to bank deposits. Walk us through a specific time a payout did not tie out: what did you check, what caused the difference, and how did you resolve it?

Whether you managed bookkeeping for more than one legal entity/company at the same time, and how you kept the books separate.



2. Where does sales tax collected from customers belong on the financial statements?



A. Revenue on the Profit and Loss statement

B. A liability on the Balance Sheet until remitted

C. An expense on the Profit and Loss statement

D. Not sure



3. Sales tax compliance experience



Have you handled sales tax compliance for an e-commerce or multi-channel business?



If yes, please describe your responsibilities, including how you tracked nexus across states, filed returns, or reconciled sales tax collected through platforms such as Shopify or Amazon against amounts remitted. Clarify which tasks you handled personally and which were handled by a platform, accountant, or tax service.



Please submit your resume link and answers to all three assessment questions to be considered.

title: YouTube Video Editor for Personal Finance & Side-Hustle Brand
description:
About Money Hacking Mama



Money Hacking Mama is a personal finance and entrepreneurship brand that helps women—especially busy moms—build wealth and create more freedom through investing, passive income, digital products, side hustles, and practical business strategies.



Our content should feel approachable, encouraging, credible, and energetic. We make money and business topics easier to understand without making viewers feel judged, overwhelmed, or talked down to.



I am looking for an experienced, dependable video editor to help turn recorded footage into engaging YouTube videos that educate viewers, hold their attention, and grow the Money Hacking Mama brand.



This is a remote, freelance contractor position open to applicants worldwide.



Responsibilities



You will:



Edit long-form, talking-head YouTube videos using raw footage, audio, and creative direction.

Remove mistakes, long pauses, repeated thoughts, filler words, and unnecessary sections while preserving my natural personality and voice.

Create a compelling opening that captures attention within the first 15–30 seconds.

Use pacing, pattern interrupts, visual variety, and storytelling techniques to improve viewer retention.

Add relevant B-roll, screenshots, screen recordings, graphics, text, captions, sound effects, and music when appropriate.

Emphasize important ideas, examples, numbers, and calls to action using on-screen text and graphics.

Improve audio quality, balance volume levels, reduce background noise, and make dialogue clear.

Perform basic color correction and maintain a consistent visual style.

Add branded elements such as colors, fonts, logos, lower thirds, transitions, and end screens.

Source only copyright-safe music, footage, graphics, and sound effects—and maintain records of licenses or source links.

Suggest places where a section could be shortened, reorganized, or clarified.

Incorporate feedback and complete revisions promptly.

Export videos using the correct YouTube settings and deliver project files in an organized format.

Create short clips from long-form videos for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or TikTok when requested.



Depending on your experience, there may also be opportunities to help with:



Thumbnail design

YouTube titles and hooks

Chapters and timestamps

Uploading and scheduling videos

Reviewing audience-retention data and improving future edits

Creating reusable editing templates and systems

The Style I’m Looking For



The editing should be:



Professional but not overly corporate

Engaging without feeling chaotic or distracting

Warm, conversational, relatable, and trustworthy

Clean and modern

Appropriate for a primarily female audience interested in money, business, side hustles, and financial freedom

Designed to support the message—not overpower it



The ideal editor understands that successful YouTube editing is not simply cutting footage. It involves storytelling, pacing, curiosity, clarity, and viewer retention.



Qualifications



You should have:



Proven experience editing YouTube videos, preferably talking-head, educational, business, finance, or creator-led content

A portfolio containing examples of relevant long-form YouTube work

Strong written and spoken English

The ability to understand humor, tone, context, and conversational English

Excellent attention to detail

A strong understanding of YouTube pacing, hooks, audience retention, and calls to action

Experience with professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

Reliable internet access and the ability to download and upload large video files

Dependable communication and the ability to meet agreed-upon deadlines

The ability to accept feedback professionally and apply it consistently

Good judgment regarding what to remove, emphasize, or visually support



Experience with personal finance, entrepreneurship, Etsy, digital products, investing, passive income, or online business is helpful but not required.



Workflow and Expectations



Initially, I expect to publish approximately 1 long-form YouTube video per week. Most finished videos will be approximately 10 minutes, although this may vary.



Raw footage and supporting assets will be shared through GOOGLE DRIVE. Communication and project management will take place through
/trello/Whatsapp.



For each assignment, I will provide the footage, brand guidelines, and any necessary notes. I also value editors who can make thoughtful creative recommendations rather than waiting for instructions on every individual cut.



Expected turnaround time is approximately 5 business days for the first draft. The agreed-upon rate should include reasonable revision rounds.



You must be able to:



Confirm that files have been received

Communicate early if a deadline may be missed

Respond during an agreed-upon communication window

Keep project files organized and backed up

Protect confidential or unpublished business information

Refrain from sharing footage or completed work without written permission



Time-zone differences are completely acceptable as long as communication is consistent and deadlines are met.



Compensation



This is a paid freelance contractor opportunity with the potential for consistent, ongoing work.



Please include the following in your application:



Your rate per completed video or preferred pricing structure

What your rate includes

The number of revisions included

Your typical turnaround time

Your typical editing time

Any additional cost for Shorts, thumbnails, captions, or uploading

Your preferred payment method



Rates should reflect your experience, portfolio, and the amount of editing required. Please do not provide a temporary introductory rate that you would be unable to maintain if the relationship becomes ongoing.



Paid Trial Project



Finalists may be invited to complete a short paid trial edit using the same raw footage and creative brief. The trial will help evaluate:



Storytelling and pacing

English comprehension

Editing judgment

Ability to follow directions

Visual creativity

Attention to detail

Communication and reliability



Completion of a paid trial does not guarantee ongoing work.



How to Apply



Please send the following:



A brief introduction and your country/time zone.

A link to your portfolio.

Two or three examples of talking-head YouTube videos you personally edited.

A short explanation of what you did on each example.

Your rate, turnaround time, and number of revisions included.

The editing software you use.

Your experience with educational, finance, business, or personal-brand content.

Your process for selecting copyright-safe music, B-roll, and graphics.

An example of how you have improved viewer retention or pacing in a previous video.

Your current availability and how many videos you can edit each month.



Please begin your application with the phrase “Financial Freedom” so I know you read the complete job description.



Also answer this question:



If you received a 20-minute talking-head video about earning passive income, what are three editing choices you would make to keep viewers watching?



Applications that do not include relevant work samples, pricing, and answers to the questions above may not be considered.



What Success Looks Like



A successful editor will help me produce videos that:



Capture attention quickly

Make financial and business information easy to understand

Keep viewers engaged without relying on excessive effects

Feel consistent with the Money Hacking Mama brand

Encourage viewers to subscribe, join my
 list, or explore a relevant resource

Can be produced consistently through a clear, dependable workflow



I am looking for someone who wants to learn the brand, improve with feedback, and potentially become a long-term creative partner.

title: B2B Cold Caller / SDR – US HVAC & Plumbing | Base + Performance Bonuses
description:
Ovrin is hiring a Philippines-based B2B cold caller / SDR to help us build a disciplined outbound sales operation for US HVAC and plumbing companies.



This is not a generic VA role.



ABOUT OVRIN



Ovrin is an AI/revenue-recovery agency focused on helping home-service businesses convert more of the leads they already pay for. Our systems can include missed-call text-back, instant web-lead response, booking reminders, estimate follow-up, no-show recovery, old-lead reactivation, review requests, and Revenue Leak reporting.



Our current core offer is approximately $1,500 setup plus $2,000–$3,000 per month. The founder will initially handle important pricing, contracts, guarantees, and unusual discounts.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Research and prospect qualified US HVAC and plumbing companies

• Cold call owners and decision-makers and navigate gatekeepers

• Explain the offer naturally—without hiding behind a script

• Qualify whether a prospect has the lead volume and revenue leaks that make Ovrin relevant

• Handle initial objections and book qualified meetings

• Follow up persistently without being spammy

• Keep clean CRM notes and accurate pipeline status

• Report activity, conversations, qualified meetings, show rate, and outcomes

• After proving yourself, potentially conduct discovery calls and take on more of the sales process



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have real experience in US B2B cold calling, outbound sales, or appointment setting. Strong spoken English and a natural, confident phone presence are essential. You need to think during conversations, listen well, handle rejection, stay organized, use a CRM consistently, and work reliably during agreed US business hours.



Experience selling SaaS, marketing, AI automation, lead generation, or other business services is valuable. HVAC, plumbing, roofing, solar, contractors, or other home-service experience is highly desirable, but not mandatory if your B2B track record is strong. Experience with offers worth thousands of dollars is a plus.



We value sales judgment, honesty, coachability, persistence, and reliability more than a flashy résumé. We want someone who can eventually operate with minimal founder supervision—not someone who blindly reads a script.



SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION



• Full-time, 40 hours per week

• Must reliably work agreed US business hours; exact time zone will be finalized with the selected candidate

• USD $600–$800/month base, depending on relevant experience and verifiable results

• Meaningful performance bonuses/commission on top of base; exact structure will be agreed before work begins

• Strong long-term growth potential for someone who consistently produces qualified, attended meetings and revenue



HIRING PROCESS



Application → shortlisted applicants → short interview → Ovrin-specific sales role-play / practical test → small paid trial where appropriate → longer-term relationship for exceptional performance.



Completing an application, interview, or practical test does not create an automatic hiring commitment.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words “LEAK FOUND.” Then provide ALL of the following:



1. A natural 60–120 second voice or video introduction. Do not read a prepared script. Explain your most relevant sales experience naturally.



2. What US B2B campaigns have you personally worked on? Include the product/service, target customer, and approximate deal size.



3. Have you sold to HVAC, plumbing, contractors, home-service businesses, or similar industries? Explain.



4. If you have done cold calling, approximately how many dials did you make per day and what percentage resulted in live conversations with actual decision-makers?



5. If you handled appointment setting, roughly how many QUALIFIED meetings did you book and how many actually showed?



6. Give a short real-world example of how you handled:

   a) a gatekeeper

   b) a prospect saying “it’s too expensive” or “we don’t need this.”



7. Have you used CRMs? Which ones?



8. Can you call using a US-local phone number/tool if Ovrin provides or approves the system?



9. Which US time zones/business hours can you reliably work?



10. What hourly/base compensation are you looking for?



11. Are you open to a compensation structure that could eventually combine base pay with meaningful performance bonuses/commission?



12. Confirm that you understand this is an outbound B2B sales role—not a general VA or customer-support role.

You'll run our TikTok Shop from end to end. That covers the daily shop operations and the affiliate program that drives most of our sales there. You'll build strong relationships with our existing creators, grow the program, and lead our planning for major sale events, including Q4.

Shop operations

- Review new creator videos for health claims and policy risks before they become a problem for the shop

- Set up promos, coupons, and campaign offers

- Monitor inventory on top SKUs and flag risks early

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Muay Thai / Martial Arts / Fitness Content
description:
Short-Form Video Editor — Muay Thai / Martial Arts / Fitness Content



The Thai Boxing Institute is a Muay Thai gym based in Los Angeles, California. We have an existing library of long-form instructional videos, training footage, classes, competition footage, and other original content.



We are looking for a video editor who can help us repurpose our existing content into high-quality short-form videos for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and other marketing platforms.



This is not just a position for someone who can cut videos and add captions.



We are looking for someone who understands how to find interesting moments inside longer videos and turn them into short pieces of content that people actually want to watch.



You can see our existing content here:







What You'll Be Doing



You will work primarily with our existing video library and new footage as it becomes available.



Your responsibilities will include:



-Reviewing long-form TBI videos and identifying strong short-form moments

-Creating Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikToks, and other vertical content

-Turning one long-form video into multiple useful pieces of content

-Creating clean, readable captions/subtitles

-Creating strong openings/hooks without using clickbait

-Tightening pacing while keeping the coaching/instruction intact

-Reframing horizontal footage for 9:16 when appropriate

-Using subtle zooms, cuts, graphics, B-roll, or other editing techniques when they actually improve the video

-Cleaning up audio when necessary

-Organizing finished content and source files

-Helping us develop a backlog of clips from our existing YouTube library



Our Style:



We are not looking for generic fitness-influencer editing.



Please avoid excessive:



Emojis

Sound effects

Meme graphics

Fake hype

Constant jump cuts

Giant animated captions

Clickbait

"3 DEADLY MUAY THAI MOVES!!!"-style content



TBI's personality is knowledgeable, technical, welcoming, community-oriented, occasionally irreverent, and rooted in actual Muay Thai training.



We want the editing to enhance that personality—not replace it.



Our Content Will Generally Fall Into Three Categories



Education



Technique breakdowns, pad holding, clinch, sweeps, defense, common mistakes, sparring concepts, fight strategy, coaching details, etc.



Culture



Members, coaches, competition team, training, gym life, seminars, travel, behind-the-scenes footage, funny moments and community.



Conversion



Content for someone considering trying TBI: beginner classes, what to expect, first-day experience, equipment, common beginner concerns, testimonials, and what makes TBI different.



Who We're Looking For



You should have experience editing short-form social media video and understand concepts such as:



-Hooks

-Retention

-Pacing

-Storytelling

-Captions

-9:16 composition

-Selecting clips from longer footage

-Creating multiple pieces of content from one source video



Experience editing martial arts, combat sports, fitness, sports, instructional or educational content is a plus, but not required.



What's more important is good taste and editorial judgment.



Software



You can use:



Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or another professional editing workflow.



We care much more about the finished product than which software you use.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself.

Links to 3 examples of short-form videos you personally edited.

Tell us which editing software you primarily use.

Tell us about your experience turning long-form content into short-form content.

Tell us approximately how long it normally takes you to create a polished 30–60 second Reel from a longer source video.

Tell us your expected hourly rate or preferred project rate.



IMPORTANT:



After looking at our YouTube channel, choose one existing TBI video and tell us:



Which specific moment would you turn into a Reel, and why?



You do NOT need to edit it.



Just tell us what you would choose and your reasoning.



Applications that do not answer this question will not be considered.



 At the very beginning of your application, write:



"TBI — I'm ready to help."

title: AI Video Editor / AI Creative Editor — Artlist AI + Kling
description:
We’re looking for a skilled AI Video Editor / AI Creative Editor who can take scripts and creative concepts and turn them into polished, cohesive AI-driven video projects.



Our team uses the Artlist AI Toolkit to bring these projects to life, so we need someone who is comfortable working within an AI generation workflow and understands how to take a project from initial concept and image generation through AI video generation and final editing.



Strong experience generating video with Kling is especially important.



A major focus of this role is character continuity. If a character appears throughout an ad, we need them to look and feel like the same person from shot to shot — consistent face, wardrobe, environment and overall visual style.



We are not looking for someone who has simply experimented with AI prompts. We need someone who knows how to actually build complete AI-driven videos.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Turn scripts and creative briefs into complete AI-generated video projects

Use the Artlist AI Toolkit as part of our production workflow

Generate high-quality AI video using Kling

Generate reference images and source imagery for scenes

Create and maintain consistent characters across multiple shots

Maintain continuity with faces, wardrobe, locations, props, lighting and visual style

Build scenes using image-to-video and text-to-video workflows

Write and refine prompts to achieve specific shots, actions and performances

Generate multiple camera angles and compositions while maintaining character continuity

Troubleshoot changing faces, inconsistent clothing, warped objects, unnatural movement and other common AI issues

Select the strongest generations and build them into cohesive sequences

Edit AI-generated footage into finished performance ads and creative projects

Add graphics, captions, typography, music and sound design where appropriate

Follow scripts and creative direction while bringing your own ideas to the execution

Organize generated assets and project files clearly

Take feedback and turn revisions around efficiently

AI SKILLS WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You should understand how to get consistent, usable footage from AI, not just impressive individual generations.



We’re especially interested in someone who understands:



Kling video generation

Artlist AI workflows

Character continuity across multiple generations

Reference image workflows

Image-to-video generation

Text-to-video generation

Prompt writing and iteration

Facial consistency

Wardrobe and prop continuity

Environment and location continuity

Camera movement and shot composition

Multiple angles of the same character or scene

Realistic human movement and performances

Knowing when a generation needs to be redone rather than forced into the edit

Combining AI generation with professional video editing

YOU’RE PROBABLY A GREAT FIT IF...

You’ve completed full AI-generated videos, not just individual AI clips

You can show examples where the same character remains recognizable across multiple shots and environments

You understand that every generation needs to feel like part of the same project

You have a strong understanding of composition, lighting, camera angles and visual storytelling

You can take a written script and determine how to visually execute each scene

You understand pacing and viewer retention

You’re comfortable combining AI-generated footage with traditional editing

You’re comfortable with Adobe Premiere Pro or similar professional editing software

After Effects or compositing experience is a plus

You’re organized and can manage large numbers of AI generations, versions and source assets

You communicate consistently with the team

You can work efficiently without sacrificing quality

You can follow creative direction without needing every individual shot spelled out for you

WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to type prompts into an AI generator.



We care about whether you can direct an AI project from beginning to end.



We care about character continuity.



We care about visual consistency.



We care about composition.



We care about storytelling.



We care about whether the final project feels intentional and professionally produced.



A great-looking individual AI clip doesn’t mean much to us if the character completely changes in the next shot.



The goal is to create AI videos that feel like one cohesive production, not a collection of unrelated generations.



WORKING WITH OUR TEAM



You’ll work alongside our creative and marketing team producing AI-driven performance ads and other creative projects.



Our team will provide access to the Artlist AI Toolkit, along with scripts, concepts, brand assets, reference material and creative direction.



We move quickly, communicate directly and expect editors to take ownership of their projects.



We want someone who can read a script, understand the creative direction and figure out how to bring it to life through AI without needing every prompt, generation or camera angle spelled out for them.



PAID TEST PROJECT



Final candidates will complete a paid AI project so we can see how you approach our workflow.



We’ll provide the script, creative direction and access to the tools needed for the project.



We’ll primarily be evaluating:



Character continuity

AI generation quality

Kling proficiency

Prompting and iteration

Shot composition

Visual consistency

Storytelling

Editing

Sound design

Overall polish



We want to see both your ability to generate the assets and turn those assets into a finished video.



TO APPLY



Please send us:



Your portfolio

Your 2–3 BEST AI-generated video projects

Links directly to the finished videos whenever possible

At least one project demonstrating character continuity across multiple shots

Examples of work created using Kling, if available

A short explanation of your process for maintaining character consistency

A list of the AI image/video tools you’re experienced with

The editing software you primarily use

Your availability during US business hours



Please do not send only individual AI generations. We want to see complete projects that demonstrate your ability to generate, direct and edit an AI video from beginning to end.



Include the word KLING somewhere in your application so we know you read the entire posting.

title: Sales Consultant / Appointment Setter – US Cleaning Company – Base + Commission
description:
WellKept Cleaning Co is a mom-owned residential and commercial cleaning company in the Atlanta, Georgia suburbs (Gwinnett County). We're growing fast and need a confident, driven sales consultant who turns conversations into booked cleanings and walkthroughs.



We don't want to hear you say you're good at sales. SHOW US. Every applicant must complete the Sales Mock Call Audition below. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Call from our ready-made lead list of 2,000+ local realtors, then property managers and small businesses

- Book walkthroughs and quote calls for move-in/move-out, turnover, and recurring commercial cleaning

- Follow up on residential quote requests and turn them into booked cleanings

- Re-engage past customers and old quotes

- Log every call and outcome in our CRM (
)



SCHEDULE

- 20 hours per week to start (4 hours/day, Monday–Friday)

- Must work US Eastern hours

- Full-time hours available for top performers: , between 9 AM and 5 PM EST



PAY

+ Base: $5/hour

+ Commission: $5 for every qualified appointment that actually takes place

+ Monthly bonus: $50 when you reach 40 completed appointments in a month

+ Top performers earn $600+/month part-time

+ Paid every 2 weeks (base + commission for appointments completed in that pay period)

+ Raises based on consistent results



WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED APPOINTMENT

+ A homeowner books a cleaning, OR a business/property decision-maker books a walkthrough or quote call

+ It actually takes place (no-shows and cancellations don't count)



REQUIREMENTS



1+ year of sales, cold calling, or appointment setting for US clients



Clear, confident spoken English



Reliable internet (10+ Mbps) with a backup connection or power source



Quiet workspace and a noise-canceling headset



Comfortable hearing "no" and still selling after "I need to think about it"



Bonus: cleaning, home services, real estate, or B2B sales experience



HOW TO APPLY



Write WELLKEPT as the first word of your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Complete the Sales Mock Call Audition below and send a LINK to the full recording (no files to download).



In 3–5 sentences: your sales experience, who you called or sold to, and your best weekly booking numbers.



Your available hours in EST.



SALES MOCK CALL AUDITION (REQUIRED)

Use ChatGPT Voice (or another AI voice assistant) to do a 5–10 minute mock sales call.



Rules:



Screen-record the WHOLE thing (Loom, OBS, or phone screen recording). We must see you paste the prompt exactly as written. No edits or cuts.



Do NOT read from a script. We want to hear your natural sales ability.



Paste this exact prompt into ChatGPT:



"You are role-playing a skeptical homeowner in the Atlanta suburbs who is considering hiring a residential cleaning company called WellKept Cleaning Co. I am the salesperson. My goal is to book your first cleaning on this call.



Before we start, secretly pick ONE of each of these for your character and do not tell me: (a) Home: 3-bed townhouse, 4-bed house with pets, or 5-bed house with young kids. (b) Reason for calling: moving out soon, overwhelmed with work, hosting an event, or had a bad experience with a previous cleaner. (c) Budget: tight, moderate, or flexible. (d) Decision-maker: you alone, or you must check with your spouse. Only reveal these details if I ask good questions. If I don't ask, don't volunteer them.



Make this a realistic call. Challenge me with several objections introduced naturally, including price ('that's more than I expected'), trust ('how do I know your cleaners are reliable?'), timing ('maybe next month'), competitors ('another company quoted me less'), and needing to think or talk to someone else. Do NOT tell me what objections are coming. Do not agree just because I give a reasonable answer. Push back at least twice before agreeing to anything, and only book if I've earned it. If I'm pushy or rude, get colder. Stay in character the entire call.



Start the call by saying: 'Hi, I was looking to get a quote for a house cleaning.'



When I say 'END CALL', step out of character and: 1) Reveal the secret details you picked, 2) Say whether you would have booked, 3) Score me 1–10 on discovery questions, building value, objection handling, confidence, and closing, with one sentence each."



Your recording must show the prompt being pasted, the full call, and the AI's scorecard at the end.



HIRING PROCESS



Audition review



15-minute video interview



1-week paid trial (base + commission). The top performer gets the role.

title: IT Infrastructure Specialist
description:
We are seeking an IT Infrastructure Implementation Specialist to bridge the gap between enterprise infrastructure design and hands-on operational deployment. In this role, you will work closely with system architects, project managers, and operations teams to deploy, configure, and validate complex IT infrastructure solutions-including server platforms, cloud environments, networking hardware, and storage systems. 



Key Responsibilities

- Execute the technical deployment of hardware, virtual systems, operating systems, networking devices, and storage infrastructure according to architectural designs and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Build, configure, and harden physical servers, hypervisors (VMware/Hyper-V), cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), and Linux/Windows server operating systems. 

- Assist in network implementation, including provisioning switches, routers, firewalls, and VPN connections under guidance from network architects.

- Partner with IT Project Managers to develop technical execution plans, implementation checklists, and rollback strategies. 

- Participate in scheduled after-hours maintenance windows, infrastructure cutovers, and migration activities to ensure minimal disruption to business operations.

- Conduct post-implementation testing, system validation, and user-acceptance verification before handoff to operation teams.

- Produce detailed technical documentation, network/system topology diagrams, and runbooks for all newly implemented systems.

- Train and transition new infrastructure solutions to the L1/L2/ IT Support and Operations teams for ongoing maintenance.

- Identify, triage, and resolve complex technical blockers and configuration errors during deployment cycles.

- Collaborate with third-party vendors and external partners for hardware provisioning, licensing, and escalation support.



Qualifications & Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- At least 2 years of hands-on experience in IT infrastructure support, systems administration, or technical deployment roles.

title: ClickUp Operations VA
description:
We are looking for a full-time ClickUp Operations VA to manage our company’s ClickUp workspace and keep our team organized.



This is not a basic admin role. You should be very comfortable with ClickUp and understand how to build and maintain a clean task-management system for a growing company.



Your main job will be to make sure nothing gets lost.



You will work directly with the founder and leadership team. We may tag you in Slack/WhatsApp and say things like:



“Add this to ClickUp.”

“Assign this to John for Friday.”

“Create a recurring task for this.”

“Update the ES project.”

“Show me what is overdue.”

“Pull all open tasks for this person.”



You should be able to handle these requests quickly and keep ClickUp accurate at all times.



Responsibilities:



* Manage our entire ClickUp workspace

* Create and assign tasks

* Set owners, deadlines, priorities, and statuses

* Create recurring tasks and responsibilities

* Maintain individual employee task dashboards

* Maintain brand/project dashboards

* Track major company initiatives

* Follow up on overdue tasks

* Keep task descriptions and organization clean

* Turn meeting action items into ClickUp tasks

* Turn Slack/WhatsApp instructions into ClickUp tasks

* Update task statuses based on team updates

* Create simple reports for leadership

* Pull open/overdue tasks by employee, brand, or project

* Help build and improve ClickUp dashboards

* Maintain ClickUp automations and templates

* Make sure completed tasks are closed properly

* Identify tasks that are stuck or missing owners

* Keep the system simple and organized



We currently operate multiple brands and departments, so you must be comfortable managing:



* Different brands

* Different teams

* Creative strategists

* Operators

* Finance

* Operations

* Leadership

* One-off company projects

* Recurring weekly responsibilities



Our creative team also uses Notion. You do NOT need to move all creative data into ClickUp. ClickUp will primarily be used for accountability, tasks, deadlines, projects, and management.



You may need to link ClickUp tasks to relevant Notion pages and help leadership pull selected information from Notion into ClickUp dashboards.



Ideal candidate:



* Advanced ClickUp experience

* Has managed ClickUp for a real company/team before

* Extremely organized

* Strong written English

* Fast response time

* Comfortable working independently

* Understands task/project management

* Good attention to detail

* Comfortable following up with team members

* Can build dashboards, custom fields, automations, recurring tasks, and templates

* Can take messy instructions and turn them into organized tasks

* Understands the difference between a task, project, recurring responsibility, and KPI

* Available full-time



Bonus:



* Notion experience

* Slack experience

* Experience supporting founders/CEOs

* Experience with e-commerce or marketing teams

* Experience managing remote teams



When applying, please answer:



1. How many years have you used ClickUp?

2. Describe the largest ClickUp workspace you have managed.

3. What ClickUp features are you strongest with?

4. Have you built executive or management dashboards before?

5. Have you managed recurring tasks and automations?

6. Have you used Notion alongside ClickUp?

7. What would you do if the founder sends you 10 messy action items from a meeting?

8. Please send screenshots or examples of ClickUp systems you have built, if possible.

9. What hours are you available in Eastern Time?

10. What is your desired monthly salary?



We are looking for someone long-term who can eventually become the owner of ClickUp organization across the entire company.

title: CREATIVE MEDIA BUYER
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



DAP Brands is looking for a Creative Media Buyer who can combine paid advertising with hands-on creative production.



You’ll manage and optimize paid campaigns while creating images, graphics, and short-form video ads for webinars, workshops, and other offers. You should understand what makes an ad perform, be comfortable testing different creative ideas, and use campaign data to continuously improve what we produce.



We’re looking for someone creative, hardworking, resourceful, detail-oriented, and willing to learn. You don't need to know everything on day one. We can train the right person, but you must already be comfortable creating images and editing videos.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



* Launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across Meta, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other platforms.

* Create and edit graphics, images, short-form videos, and other ad creatives.

* Develop hooks, concepts, messaging, and creative variations for different audiences and awareness stages.

* Research competitors, trends, and winning ad creatives to identify new ideas.

* Apply Direct Response Marketing principles to paid campaigns and creative assets.

* Test different creative angles, formats, hooks, and messaging to improve performance.

* Use AI and creative tools to produce and iterate content efficiently.

* Analyze campaign and creative performance and use the data to guide future creative decisions.

* Collaborate with Marketing and Revenue teams on campaigns, offers, and creative strategy.

* Manage multiple campaigns and creative projects while meeting deadlines and maintaining quality.

* Continuously look for ways to improve creative output, campaign performance, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS



* 1+ year of hands-on media buying experience, preferably with Meta Ads.

* Hands-on experience creating graphics/images and editing short-form videos.

* Proficiency in Figma, Canva, CapCut, Adobe, or similar creative tools.

* Experience with Meta Ads Manager or other paid advertising platforms.

* Strong understanding of creative testing and performance metrics such as CTR, CPL, CPA, and ROAS.

* Ability to create different hooks, angles, and creative variations for testing.

* Understanding of Direct Response Marketing and audience awareness stages is a strong advantage.

* Experience with AI creative tools is a plus.

* Experience with coaching, education, information products, webinars, or high-ticket offers is a plus.

* Strong work ethic, resourcefulness, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

* Comfortable working in a high-performance, fast-moving environment and producing creative at a high volume.



WHAT WE VALUE



We value people who take ownership, learn quickly, find solutions, pay attention to detail, and follow through.



We're looking for someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do. You should be able to spot an opportunity, create something, test it, learn from the results, and improve.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through the DAP Careers Page: 



Important: Add "MAVERICK" before your full name when applying.



OR


 your résumé to
